_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Objects.xnb item DESCRIPTIONS, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Japanese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "japanese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation of the whole sentence, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, reading, gloss} where every segment's "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "japanese" (validated programmatically). Grammatical particles (wa/ga/o/ni/no/to etc.) are their own segment with a bracketed functional gloss like "(subject marker)" rather than being folded into a neighboring word. Trailing punctuation is folded into the preceding word segment rather than given its own. Generated for the LanguageStardewValleyMod project.

Acorn_Description.japanese: 植えるとオークの木が育つ。
Acorn_Description.english: If you plant it, an oak tree grows.

AdvancedTVRemote_Description.japanese: 普通のリモコンよりもボタンの数が多い。テレビに夢中な人にはもってこい！
AdvancedTVRemote_Description.english: It has more buttons than a normal remote. It's perfect for someone who's obsessed with TV!

Aerinite_Description.japanese: 魅力的なきらめきをもつ鉱物。
Aerinite_Description.english: A mineral with a charming sparkle.

AgedRoe_Description.japanese: 風味を引き出すために塩で熟成させた魚の卵。
AgedRoe_Description.english: Fish eggs matured in salt to draw out their flavor.

Alamite_Description.japanese: 紫外線を当てると独特の光をはなつため、鉱物コレクターのあいだで人気。
Alamite_Description.english: Popular among mineral collectors because it emits a distinctive glow when exposed to ultraviolet light.

Albacore_Description.japanese: 冷たい海流とあたたかい海流が出会う「潮目」に好んで生息する。
Albacore_Description.english: Prefers to live at the 'tide line' where cold and warm ocean currents meet.

AlgaeSoup_Description.japanese: ちょっとぬるっとしている。

AmaranthSeeds_Description.japanese: 秋植えの作物。そだつのに7日かかる。収穫にはカマが必要。
AmaranthSeeds_Description.english: A fall-planted crop. Takes 7 days to grow. A scythe is needed to harvest.

Amaranth_Description.japanese: 古代から作られていたむらさき色の穀物。
Amaranth_Description.english: A purple grain that has been cultivated since ancient times.

AmethystRing_Description.japanese: ノックバック力が10%上がる。

AmethystStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとアメシストが手に入る。
AmethystStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain amethyst.

Amethyst_Description.japanese: むらさき色をした水晶の一種。
Amethyst_Description.english: A type of quartz that is purple in color.

AmphibianFossil_Description.japanese: じゃっかん短い後ろ足から考えると、ヒキガエルの先祖だと思われる。
AmphibianFossil_Description.english: Judging from its somewhat short hind legs, it's thought to be an ancestor of the toad.

Anchor_Description.japanese: 大むかしの海賊たちがつかっていたものかもしれない。
Anchor_Description.english: It might be something ancient pirates used.

Anchovy_Description.japanese: 海に生息する銀色の小魚。
Anchovy_Description.english: A small silver fish that lives in the sea.

AncientDoll_Description.japanese: ほこりにまみれた大むかしの人形。オモチャだったのかもしれないし、装飾品、はたまた儀式用の人形だったのかもしれない。
AncientDoll_Description.english: An ancient doll covered in dust. It might have been a toy, a decoration, or perhaps a doll used for rituals.

AncientDrum_Description.japanese: 木に動物の皮を張ってつくられた打楽器。よくひびく低い音色が持ち味。
AncientDrum_Description.english: A percussion instrument made by stretching animal hide over wood. Its charm is a low tone that resonates well.

AncientFruit_Description.japanese: 永遠の眠りからめざめたタネが実らせた。
AncientFruit_Description.english: A seed that awoke from an eternal sleep bore this fruit.

AncientSeed_Description.japanese: 古びて乾燥した古代の植物のタネ。一見、芽が出るようには思えないが…
AncientSeed_Description.english: An old, dried-out seed from some ancient plant. At a glance it doesn't look like it would sprout, but...

AncientSeeds_Description.japanese: 植えてもまだそだつかな？
AncientSeeds_Description.english: I wonder if this would still grow if planted?

AncientSword_Description.japanese: 現代にのこった古代の剣。刃のほとんどはサビてしまっているが、その柄の精巧さはいまだ健在。
AncientSword_Description.english: An ancient sword that has survived to the present day. Most of the blade has rusted away, but the elaborate craftsmanship of its hilt is still intact.

Angler_Description.japanese: 頭からぶら下がった光る突起でエサを釣る習性がある。
Angler_Description.english: Has a habit of luring prey with a glowing projection dangling from its head.

AppleSapling_Description.japanese: 28日かけて成木にそだち、秋になるとくだものを実らせる。となりあった周囲の「8マス」が空いていないとそだたない。
AppleSapling_Description.english: Takes 28 days to grow into a mature tree, and bears fruit in autumn. Won't grow unless the surrounding '8 squares' are empty.

Apple_Description.japanese: 歯ごたえがいいくだもの。ジュースやサイダーの材料になる。
Apple_Description.english: A fruit with a good crunch (ha-gotae). Becomes an ingredient for juice or cider.

ApricotSapling_Description.japanese: 28日かけて成木にそだち、春になるとくだものを実らせる。となりあった周囲の「8マス」が空いていないとそだたない。
ApricotSapling_Description.english: Takes 28 days to grow into a mature tree, and bears fruit in spring. Won't grow unless the surrounding '8 squares' are empty.

Apricot_Description.japanese: 小さなくだもの。石のようにかたいタネを、やわらかい果肉が包んでいる。
Apricot_Description.english: A small fruit. Soft flesh wraps around a stone-hard pit.

AquamarineRing_Description.japanese: クリティカルの発生率が10%上がる。

AquamarineStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとアクアマリンが手に入る。
AquamarineStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain aquamarine.

Aquamarine_Description.japanese: 緑がかったブルーにきらめく宝石。
Aquamarine_Description.english: A gem that sparkles in a greenish blue.

ArcticShard_Description.japanese: 幻想的な青い光を放っている。
ArcticShard_Description.english: It gives off a fantastical (genso-teki) blue light.

Arrowhead_Description.japanese: 狩りにつかわれていた、粗野なつくりの矢じり。
Arrowhead_Description.english: A crudely made arrowhead that was used for hunting.

ArtichokeDip_Description.japanese: アーティチョークのフレッシュな味を楽しめる。ひやしていただく。
ArtichokeDip_Description.english: You can enjoy the fresh taste of artichoke. Best served chilled.

ArtichokeSeeds_Description.japanese: 秋植えの作物。そだつのに8日かかる。
ArtichokeSeeds_Description.english: A fall-planted crop. Takes 8 days to grow.

Artichoke_Description.japanese: アザミの花を改良した野菜。つぼみを食べる。トゲトゲの葉が肉づきのいい中身を守っている。
Artichoke_Description.english: A vegetable improved from the thistle (azami) flower. You eat the bud. Its thorny leaves protect a fleshy interior.

ArtifactSpot_Description.japanese: えっと…どうやって持ち物に入れたの？ヘンなことする人もいるもんだね。
ArtifactSpot_Description.english: Um... how did you get this into your inventory? Some people do strange things.

ArtifactTrove_Description.japanese: 鍛冶屋が開けられます。この墓は古代の遺物や珍品を含んでいることがよくあります。
ArtifactTrove_Description.english: A blacksmith can open it for you. This grave (haka) often contains ancient relics and curiosities.

AutumnsBounty_Description.japanese: 秋の味覚がそろった一皿。
AutumnsBounty_Description.english: A dish that gathers together the flavors of autumn.

Bait_Description.japanese: 魚の食いつきがよくなる。釣るまえに釣りざおにセットしてつかう。
Bait_Description.english: Makes fish bite better. Used by attaching it to a fishing rod before fishing.

BakedFish_Description.japanese: 焼いた魚にハーブをそえた一品。
BakedFish_Description.english: A dish of grilled fish accompanied by herbs.

BananaPudding_Description.japanese: トロピカルな味わいが魅力の、クリーミーなデザート。
BananaPudding_Description.english: A creamy dessert whose charm is its tropical flavor.

BananaSapling_Description.japanese: 28日かけてバナナの成木になる。夏になるとバナナを実らせる。ジンジャーアイランドで育てると1年を通じて実をつける。
BananaSapling_Description.english: Takes 28 days to become a mature banana tree. Bears bananas in summer. If grown on Ginger Island, it bears fruit all year round.

segments.text: ジンジャーアイランド

Banana_Description.japanese: 甘くてデンプンが豊富なトロピカルフルーツ。
Banana_Description.english: A sweet tropical fruit rich in starch.

BarbedHook_Description.japanese: 魚をより確実に釣りあげるための針。セットすると釣りバーが魚にくっついて動くようになる。スピードがおそい魚ほど釣りやすい。
BarbedHook_Description.english: A hook for landing fish more reliably. Once equipped, the 'fishing bar' sticks to and moves with the fish. Easier the slower the fish.

Baryte_Description.japanese: 良質な標本は、砂漠のバラという名で知られる。
Baryte_Description.english: Fine specimens are known by the name 'desert rose.'

Basalt_Description.japanese: カンカンに熱い溶岩の近くで生まれる岩石。
Basalt_Description.english: A rock formed near scorching-hot (kan-kan ni atsui) lava.

BasicFertilizer_Description.japanese: 土の質をよくして、高品質な作物ができる確率を少し上げる。たがやした土に混ぜてつかう。
BasicFertilizer_Description.english: Improves soil quality, slightly raising the chance of growing high-quality crops. Mix into tilled soil.

BasicRetainingSoil_Description.japanese: 土の保水力を上げ、次の日まで湿りけを保っていられる確率を上げる。たがやした土に混ぜてつかう。
BasicRetainingSoil_Description.english: Raises the soil's water-retention, increasing the chance it stays moist until the next day. Mix into tilled soil.

BatWing_Description.japanese: おどろくほどもろい素材。

BatteryPack_Description.japanese: 役だつ貴重なエネルギーがつまっている。
BatteryPack_Description.english: Packed full of precious, useful energy.

BeanHotpot_Description.japanese: ヘルシーなことまちがいなし。
BeanHotpot_Description.english: No mistaking it, this is healthy.

BeanStarter_Description.japanese: 春植えの作物。成長まで10日かかるが、そのあともくりかえし収穫が可能で。支柱にからみながらそだつ。
BeanStarter_Description.english: A spring-planted crop. Takes 10 days to grow, but can be harvested repeatedly after that. Grows while twining around a trellis.

BeetSeeds_Description.japanese: 秋植えの作物。そだつのに6日かかる。
BeetSeeds_Description.english: A fall-planted crop. Takes 6 days to grow.

Beet_Description.japanese: 大地の香りがするあまい根菜。葉はサラダにして食べられる。
Beet_Description.english: A sweet root vegetable that smells of the earth. The leaves can be eaten as a salad.

BerryBasket_Description.japanese: あちこちにベリーの汁で染みができている。
BerryBasket_Description.english: It's stained here and there with berry juice.

Bixite_Description.japanese: メタリックな黒い鉱物。キューブのような形状が人気。
Bixite_Description.english: A metallic black mineral. Its cube-like shape is popular.

BlackberryCobbler_Description.japanese: ほかに並ぶもののないおいしさ。
BlackberryCobbler_Description.english: A deliciousness unmatched by anything else.

Blackberry_Description.japanese: おやつにちょうどいい秋のベリー。
Blackberry_Description.english: An autumn berry that's just right for a snack.

Blobfish_Description.japanese: 海底の上の方にいる、きみょうな生き物。ただよいながら、いろんな素材を食べて生きている
Blobfish_Description.english: A strange creature that lives just above the sea floor. It lives by drifting along and eating various materials.

BlueDiscus_Description.japanese: 色鮮やかな熱帯魚。水族館の人気者。
BlueDiscus_Description.english: A vividly colored tropical fish. A favorite at aquariums.

BlueGrassStarter_Description.japanese: 牧場で青葉を育てるためのキット。植えれば青葉が生えてくる。
BlueGrassStarter_Description.english: A kit for growing blue leaf on the ranch. If planted, blue leaf will grow.

BlueJazz_Description.japanese: 小さな花がかたまって球状になっている。チョウはこの花を好んであつまる。
BlueJazz_Description.english: Small flowers cluster together into a sphere shape. Butterflies love to gather at this flower.

BlueSlimeEgg_Description.japanese: スライム用ふ卵器でかえすことができる。
BlueSlimeEgg_Description.english: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.

BlueberrySeeds_Description.japanese: 夏植えの作物。そだつのに13日かかるが、最初の収穫のあともくりかえし収穫できる。
BlueberrySeeds_Description.english: A summer-planted crop. Takes 13 days to grow, but can be harvested repeatedly after the first harvest.

BlueberryTart_Description.japanese: さわやかさをたたえた絶妙な一品。
BlueberryTart_Description.english: An exquisite dish full of refreshing flavor.

Blueberry_Description.japanese: 健康にいいとされることで有名なベリー。皮に一番栄養がある。
Blueberry_Description.english: A berry famous for reportedly having many health benefits. The skin has the most nutrition.

BokChoySeeds_Description.japanese: 秋植えの作物。そだつのに4日かかる。
BokChoySeeds_Description.english: A fall-planted crop. Takes 4 days to grow.

BokChoy_Description.japanese: 茎と葉をたべるおいしい葉もの野菜。食物せんいたっぷり。
BokChoy_Description.english: A delicious leafy vegetable whose stems and leaves are eaten. Full of dietary fiber.

Bomb_Description.japanese: 爆発を起こす。取りあつかい注意！
Bomb_Description.english: Causes an explosion. Handle with care!

BoneFlute_Description.japanese: 動物のホネをけずってつくられた、有史以前の管楽器。吹くと気味の悪い音色をひびかせる。
BoneFlute_Description.english: A prehistoric wind instrument made by carving an animal's bone. When blown, it produces an eerie tone.

Book_AnimalCatalogue_Description.japanese: マーニーがいないときでもマーニーの店を利用できる。
Book_AnimalCatalogue_Description.english: You can use Marnie's shop even when Marnie isn't there.

Book_Artifact_Description.japanese: 発掘品の売り値が高くなる。
Book_Artifact_Description.english: The selling price of excavated items becomes higher.

Book_Bombs_Description.japanese: ボムから受けるダメージが25%減少する。
Book_Bombs_Description.english: Damage taken from bombs is reduced by 25%.

Book_Crabbing_Description.japanese: カニかごの水揚げが25%の確率で2倍になる。
Book_Crabbing_Description.english: With 25% probability, a crab pot's catch is doubled.

Book_Diamonds_Description.japanese: 手作業で採掘すると、すべての石からダイヤモンドがドロップする可能性がある。
Book_Diamonds_Description.english: When mined by hand, there's a chance any stone can drop a diamond.

Book_Friendship_Description.japanese: 住人と友達になるのが少しだけ早くなる。
Book_Friendship_Description.english: Becoming friends with residents happens a little faster.

Book_Marlon_Description.japanese: マーロンのアイテム回収サービスが50%割引になる。
Book_Marlon_Description.english: Marlon's item retrieval service becomes 50% off.

segments.text: アイテム回収サービス

Book_Mystery_Description.japanese: ミステリーボックスが見つかる確率が少し上がる。
Book_Mystery_Description.english: The probability of finding a Mystery Box rises a little.

Book_PriceCatalogue_Description.japanese: あなたのアイテムの値段が分かるようになる。
Book_PriceCatalogue_Description.english: You become able to know the price of your items.

Book_QueenOfSauce_Description.japanese: まだ知らないソースの女王のレシピを学ぼう。
Book_QueenOfSauce_Description.english: Let's learn a Queen of Sauce recipe you don't know yet.

Book_Riding_Description.japanese: 乗馬したときのスピードが少しアップする。
Book_Riding_Description.english: Your speed rises a little when riding a horse.

Book_Roe_Description.japanese: 宝箱から魚卵が手に入ることがある。
Book_Roe_Description.english: Sometimes fish eggs (roe) can be obtained from treasure chests.

Book_Speed2_Description.english: You can run a little bit faster.

Book_Speed_Description.english: You can run a little bit faster.

Book_Trash_Description.japanese: ゴミ箱からアイテムが見つかる確率が上がる。
Book_Trash_Description.english: The probability of finding an item from a trash can rises.

Book_Void_Description.japanese: モンスターがまれに2倍のアイテムを落とす。

Book_WildSeeds_Description.japanese: 雑草からミックスシードが入手できる確率が上がる。
Book_WildSeeds_Description.english: The probability of obtaining mixed seeds from weeds rises.

Book_Woodcutting_Description.japanese: 伐採した木から5%の確率で2倍の木材を入手できる。
Book_Woodcutting_Description.english: With 5% probability, a felled tree yields double wood.

Bouquet_Description.japanese: 自分の恋心を相手に伝えるプレゼント。
Bouquet_Description.english: A gift that conveys your romantic feelings to the other person.

Bream_Description.japanese: 夜に活発になる魚。川でそこそこよくみかける。
Bream_Description.english: A fish that becomes active at night. Fairly often seen in rivers.

BrickFloor_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して、道をつくったり地面を整えたりできる。
BrickFloor_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

BroccoliSeeds_Description.japanese: 秋植えの作物。そだつのに8日かかるが、つづけて収穫することができる。
BroccoliSeeds_Description.english: A fall-planted crop. Takes 8 days to grow, but can be harvested continuously.

Broccoli_Description.japanese: ブロッコリーのつぼみの集まり。小さなつぼみが独特の食感を生む。
Broccoli_Description.english: A cluster of broccoli buds. The small buds create a distinctive texture.

BrokenCD_Description.japanese: JojaNet 2.0のトライアルCD。きっと大量につくられたにちがいない。
BrokenCD_Description.english: A JojaNet 2.0 trial CD. They must have surely made a huge number of these.

BrokenGlasses_Description.japanese: だれかの落としもの。完全に割れてしまっている。
BrokenGlasses_Description.english: Something someone dropped. It's completely broken.

BrownEgg_Description.japanese: 茶色いニワトリのタマゴ。

Bruschetta_Description.japanese: ローストしたトマトをサクサクの白いパンに乗せた一品。
Bruschetta_Description.english: A dish of roasted tomato placed on crispy white bread.

BugMeat_Description.japanese: 体液がしたたる虫の肉のかたまり。
BugMeat_Description.english: A lump of bug meat dripping with bodily fluid.

BugSteak_Description.japanese: お腹を空かせた洞窟探検家の最後の手段。
BugSteak_Description.english: The last resort of a hungry cave explorer.

Bullhead_Description.japanese: 池や湖の底でエサをあさって生きる、雑食性のナマズの仲間。
Bullhead_Description.english: An omnivorous relative of the catfish that lives by scavenging for food on the bottom of ponds and lakes.

BurglarsRing_Description.japanese: モンスターがアイテムを落とす確率が上がる。
BurglarsRing_Description.english: The probability of monsters dropping items rises.

ButterflyPowder_Description.japanese: ペットに振りかけると牧場から追い出すことができる。ペットは二度と帰ってこない。
ButterflyPowder_Description.english: If sprinkled on a pet, you can drive it away from the farm. The pet never comes back.

CactusFruit_Description.japanese: ウチワサボテンに実るあまいフルーツ。
CactusFruit_Description.english: A sweet fruit that grows on the prickly pear cactus.

CactusSeeds_Description.japanese: 屋内でしか育たない。そだつのに12日かかる。その後は3日ごとにくだものがなる
CactusSeeds_Description.english: Only grows indoors. Takes 12 days to grow. After that it bears fruit every 3 days.

Calcite_Description.japanese: イエローの結晶のなかには、きらきら光る点が散らばっている。
Calcite_Description.english: Inside the yellow crystal, glittering points are scattered about.

CalicoEggStone_Description.japanese: 割るとカリコエッグが手に入る。
CalicoEggStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain a Calico Egg.

CalicoEgg_Description.japanese: 砂漠フェスティバルで目にする特別なタマゴ。
CalicoEgg_Description.english: A special egg that you see at the Desert Festival.

CampingStove_Description.japanese: どこでも料理が出来るようになる。何度でも使える。
CampingStove_Description.english: You become able to cook anywhere. Can be used any number of times.

CarpSurprise_Description.japanese: 油っぽいが味はシンプル。
CarpSurprise_Description.english: It's oily, but the taste is simple.

Carp_Description.japanese: 池や沼でよくみかける魚。
Carp_Description.english: A fish often seen in ponds and marshes.

CarrotSeeds_Description.japanese: 春植えの作物。そだつのに3日かかる。
CarrotSeeds_Description.english: A spring-planted crop. Takes 3 days to grow.

Carrot_Description.japanese: 成長が早くカラフルな根菜。おやつに最適。
Carrot_Description.english: A fast-growing, colorful root vegetable. Perfect for a snack.

Catfish_Description.japanese: 小川に生息する魚。めったにみかけない。
Catfish_Description.english: A fish that lives in streams. Rarely seen.

CauliflowerSeeds_Description.japanese: 春植えの作物。12日で大きなカリフラワーが収穫できる。
CauliflowerSeeds_Description.english: A spring-planted crop. In 12 days you can harvest a large cauliflower.

Cauliflower_Description.japanese: 価値が高いが育つのはおそい。色はうすくても、つぼみには栄養がぎっしりつまっている。
Cauliflower_Description.english: High in value, but slow to grow. Even though its color is pale, the florets are packed tightly with nutrition.

CaveCarrot_Description.japanese: 洞窟に生えるでんぷん質の根っこ。坑夫たちのおやつとして知られる。
CaveCarrot_Description.english: A starchy root that grows in caves. Known as a snack for miners.

CaveJelly_Description.japanese: 地下湖で見つかる珍しいゼリー
CaveJelly_Description.english: A rare jelly found in underground lakes.

Caviar_Description.japanese: チョウザメの卵。贅沢な美味しさ！

Celestine_Description.japanese: 原初の生命は、この石をもとにして骨格を得たと言われている。
Celestine_Description.english: It's said that primordial life obtained its skeleton based on this stone.

ChallengeBait_Description.japanese: パーフェクトで釣り上げると3匹の魚が釣れる。魚が「釣りバー」の外に逃げるたびに釣れる数が減る。
ChallengeBait_Description.english: A perfect catch lands 3 fish. Each time the fish escapes outside the 'fishing bar,' the number caught decreases.

Chanterelle_Description.japanese: おいしいキノコ。フルーティーな香りのなかに、ちょっぴりコショウの香りが混じる。
Chanterelle_Description.english: A delicious mushroom. Within its fruity aroma, a bit of a peppery scent is mixed in.

CheeseCauliflower_Description.japanese: 焦がしチーズのかおりが最高！
CheeseCauliflower_Description.english: The aroma of browned cheese is the best!

Cheese_Description.japanese: ふつうの自家製チーズ。

CherryBomb_Description.japanese: せまい範囲に爆発を起こす。つかうときは下がること！
CherryBomb_Description.english: Causes an explosion in a narrow area. Stand back when using it!

CherrySapling_Description.japanese: 28日かけて成木にそだち、春になるとくだものを実らせる。となりあった周囲の「8マス」が空いていないとそだたない。
CherrySapling_Description.english: Takes 28 days to grow into a mature tree, and bears fruit in spring. Won't grow unless the surrounding '8 squares' are empty.

Cherry_Description.japanese: 万人に愛されているくだもの。ほかのくだものより熟するのがはやい。
Cherry_Description.english: A fruit loved by everyone. Ripens sooner than other fruits.

ChewingStick_Description.japanese: 古代の人びとは、こういった棒を噛んで歯をきれいに保っていた。
ChewingStick_Description.english: Ancient people kept their teeth clean by chewing sticks like this.

ChickenStatue_Description.japanese: 青銅製の台に乗ったニワトリの彫像。このあたりに住んでいた古代の人びとは、ニワトリが大好きだったにちがいない。
ChickenStatue_Description.english: A chicken statue on a bronze pedestal. The ancient people who lived around here must have loved chickens.

ChippedAmphora_Description.japanese: 土を窯で焼いてつくった古代のつぼ。液体やものを運ぶのにつかわれていた。
ChippedAmphora_Description.english: An ancient jar made by firing clay in a kiln. It was used to carry liquids and goods.

ChocolateCake_Description.japanese: 濃厚でしっとりした生地に砂糖衣がたっぷり。
ChocolateCake_Description.english: Rich, moist dough with plenty of sugar icing.

Chowder_Description.japanese: 海でさむい夜をすごしたあとは、これでからだをあたためるのが一番。
Chowder_Description.english: After spending a cold night at sea, this is the best way to warm your body.

Chub_Description.japanese: 淡水でよくみかける魚。大食いなことで知られる。
Chub_Description.english: A fish often seen in fresh water. Known for its huge appetite.

CinderShardStone_Description.japanese: 砕くと噴石のかけらが手に入る。
CinderShardStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain a cinder shard.

CinderShard_Description.japanese: この石からは、ほんのりと温かさを感じる。
CinderShard_Description.english: You can feel a faint warmth from this stone.

ClayStone_Description.japanese: 砕くと粘土が手に入る。
ClayStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain clay.

Clay_Description.japanese: クラフトや建築に利用できる。
Clay_Description.english: Can be used for crafting and construction.

Cloth_Description.japanese: 上質なウールで織られたひと束の布。
Cloth_Description.english: A bundle of cloth woven from high-quality wool.

Coal_Description.japanese: クラフトや精錬でよくつかう、燃やせる炭のかたまり。
Coal_Description.english: A combustible lump of coal often used in crafting and smelting.

CobblestonePath_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して道をつくったり、地面を整えたりできる。
CobblestonePath_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

Cockle_Description.japanese: 海でよくみられる2枚貝。
Cockle_Description.english: A bivalve often seen in the sea.

Coconut_Description.japanese: ココやしの木になる実。いろんな料理に利用できる。
Coconut_Description.english: A fruit that grows on the coconut palm tree. Used in various dishes.

CoffeeBean_Description.japanese: 夏に植えるとコーヒーの木がそだつ。とれた豆は、5つ醸造ダルに入れればコーヒーができる。
CoffeeBean_Description.english: If planted in summer, a coffee tree grows. Put 5 harvested beans into a keg to make coffee.

Coffee_Description.japanese: かぐわしい香りの飲みもの。飲めばからだがシャキッとする。
Coffee_Description.english: A fragrant drink. Drinking it perks up your body.

Coleslaw_Description.japanese: シャキッとさわやか、ヘルシーな味。

CommonMushroom_Description.japanese: 食感がよくておいしいキノコ。ほのかにナッツの香りがする。
CommonMushroom_Description.english: A mushroom with good texture and good taste. It has a faint nutty aroma.

CompleteBreakfast_Description.japanese: これを食べれば、世界におはようを言う準備は万端！
CompleteBreakfast_Description.english: Eat this, and you'll be fully ready to say good morning to the world!

CookoutKit_Description.japanese: 料理用キャンプファイヤーを使って、外出先で料理をしよう！
CookoutKit_Description.english: Use a cooking campfire and cook while out and about!

CopperOre_Description.japanese: ありふれた鉱石。精錬してのべ棒にできる。
CopperOre_Description.english: A common ore. Can be smelted into an ingot.

CopperStone_Description.japanese: なかに銅鉱石がふくまれている。

Coral_Description.japanese: とても小さな生きものの群れがあつまり、うつくしい形をとったもの。
Coral_Description.english: A gathering of colonies of very tiny creatures that has taken on a beautiful shape.

CorkBobber_Description.japanese: 釣りバーのおおきさをちょっとだけ上げる。
CorkBobber_Description.english: Slightly raises the size of the 'fishing bar.'

CornSeeds_Description.japanese: 夏または秋植えの作物。そだつのに14日かかるが、最初の収穫のあともくりかえし収穫できる。
CornSeeds_Description.english: A summer- or fall-planted crop. Takes 14 days to grow, but can be harvested repeatedly after the first harvest.

Corn_Description.japanese: ポピュラーな穀物のひとつ。もぎたてのあまい実は夏の人気者。
Corn_Description.english: One of the popular grains. Its freshly picked sweet kernels are a summer favorite.

CrabCakes_Description.japanese: カニの身、パン粉、タマゴをあわせたパテをキツネ色になるまで揚げた一品。
CrabCakes_Description.english: A patty combining crab meat, breadcrumbs, and egg, fried until golden brown.

CrabPot_Description.japanese: 水のなかにしずめ、釣りエサをセットしてつかう。つぎの日チェックすれば、きっとなにかが入っているはず。川や池、湖、海に設置できる。
CrabPot_Description.english: Used by sinking it in the water and setting bait. Check the next day and something should surely be inside. Can be placed in rivers, ponds, lakes, or the sea.

Crab_Description.japanese: 海にすむ甲殻類。2つのパワフルなハサミをもつ。
Crab_Description.english: A crustacean that lives in the sea. Has two powerful pincers.

CrabshellRing_Description.japanese: リングの上部は、魅惑のカニの殻でできています。
CrabshellRing_Description.english: The top of the ring is made from an enchanting crab shell.

Cranberries_Description.japanese: すっぱくて赤いベリー。むかしから冬の食料として食べられてきた。
Cranberries_Description.english: A sour red berry. Has been eaten as winter food since long ago.

CranberryCandy_Description.japanese: クランベリーのほのかな苦みがアクセント。
CranberryCandy_Description.english: The faint bitterness of cranberry is the accent.

CranberrySauce_Description.japanese: 祝日のお祝いにはかかせない。

CranberrySeeds_Description.japanese: 秋植えの作物。そだつのに7日かかる。最初の収穫のあともくりかえし収穫できる。
CranberrySeeds_Description.english: A fall-planted crop. Takes 7 days to grow. Can be harvested repeatedly after the first harvest.

Crayfish_Description.japanese: 淡水にすむ小さいロブスターの仲間。
Crayfish_Description.english: A small relative of the lobster that lives in fresh water.

Crimsonfish_Description.japanese: ふだんは深海にすんでいるが、夏になって水が温まると産卵しに浮上してくる。
Crimsonfish_Description.english: Normally lives in the deep sea, but when the water warms in summer it rises to the surface to spawn.

CrispyBass_Description.japanese: サクサクのパン粉が最高。
CrispyBass_Description.english: The crispy breadcrumbs are the best.

Crocus_Description.japanese: 冬にも花ひらくきれいな花。
Crocus_Description.english: A pretty flower that blooms even in winter.

CrystalFloor_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して、道をつくったり地面を整えたりできる。
CrystalFloor_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

CrystalFruit_Description.japanese: 雪のなかからあらわれる、繊細でおいしいフルーツ。
CrystalFruit_Description.english: A delicate, delicious fruit that appears out of the snow.

CrystalPath_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して道をつくったり、地面を整えたりできる。
CrystalPath_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

CuriosityLure_Description.japanese: めずらしい魚を釣る確立が上がる。
CuriosityLure_Description.english: The probability of catching a rare fish rises.

Daffodil_Description.japanese: 古くから親しまれている春の花。贈りものによろこばれる。
Daffodil_Description.english: A spring flower that has long been beloved. Well-received as a gift.

Dandelion_Description.japanese: 花はパッとしないが、葉っぱがおいしいサラダになる。
Dandelion_Description.english: The flower isn't flashy, but the leaves make a delicious salad.

DecorativePot_Description.japanese: 古代のつぼのレプリカ。
DecorativePot_Description.english: A replica of an ancient jar.

DeluxeBait_Description.japanese: 魚の食いつきがさらによくなり、「釣りバー」のサイズが大きくなる。
DeluxeBait_Description.english: Fish bite even better, and the size of the 'fishing bar' grows larger.

DeluxeFertilizer_Description.japanese: 土の質を大きく向上させて、高品質な作物ができる確率をぐっと上げるたがやした土に混ぜてつかう。
DeluxeFertilizer_Description.english: Greatly improves soil quality, considerably raising the chance of growing high-quality crops. Mix into tilled soil.

DeluxeRetainingSoil_Description.japanese: 土の保水力を上げ、次の日まで湿り気を100%保つ。たがやした土に混ぜてつかう。
DeluxeRetainingSoil_Description.english: Raises the soil's water-retention, keeping it moist until the next day 100% of the time. Mix into tilled soil.

DeluxeSpeedGro_Description.japanese: 葉の成長を促進し、作物の成長速度を少なくとも25%上げる。たがやした土に混ぜてつかう。
DeluxeSpeedGro_Description.english: Promotes leaf growth, raising crop growth speed by at least 25%. Mix into tilled soil.

DiamondStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとダイヤモンドが手に入る。
DiamondStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain diamonds.

DinosaurEgg_Description.japanese: 巨大な恐竜のタマゴ。カラがそっくり割れないままで残っている！
DinosaurEgg_Description.english: A giant dinosaur egg. The shell remains entirely unbroken!

DinosaurMayonnaise_Description.japanese: 鮮やかな緑色の色調で濃厚かつクリーミーです。草や革のような香りがします。
DinosaurMayonnaise_Description.english: It has a vivid green hue, and is thick and creamy. It smells like grass and leather.

DishOTheSea_Description.japanese: 海風が冷たくても、これを食べればあたたまる。
DishOTheSea_Description.english: Even if the sea breeze is cold, eating this will warm you up.

Dolomite_Description.japanese: もとはサンゴ礁だった鉱物。海底火山の近くでみられる。
Dolomite_Description.english: A mineral that was originally a coral reef. Found near underwater volcanoes.

Dorado_Description.japanese: どうもうな肉食魚。あざやかなオレンジのうろこをもつ。
Dorado_Description.english: A ferocious carnivorous fish. Has vivid orange scales.

DragonTooth_Description.japanese: 古代のヘビの歯だというウワサ。エナメル質が純イリジウムでできている！
DragonTooth_Description.english: Rumored to be the teeth of an ancient serpent. The enamel is made of pure iridium!

DressedSpinner_Description.japanese: 金属の板とカラフルなリボンが、魚の注意をひきつける。つかうと釣りゲージがたまりやすくなる。
DressedSpinner_Description.english: A metal plate and colorful ribbons draw the fish's attention. Using it makes the fishing gauge fill more easily.

DriedFruit_Description.japanese: 歯ごたえのあるドライ{0}。

DriedMushrooms_Description.japanese: グルメなキノコの一品

DriedStarfish_Description.japanese: 原始時代に生息してたヒトデの化石。こんなにきれいな状態で見つかるのは珍しい！
DriedStarfish_Description.english: The fossil of a starfish that lived in primordial times. It's rare to find one in such a beautiful state!

Driftwood_Description.japanese: 海から流れてきた木片。
Driftwood_Description.english: A piece of wood that drifted from the sea.

DrumBlock_Description.japanese: 上を歩くとドラムの音が鳴る。
DrumBlock_Description.english: A drum sound plays when you walk on top.

DuckEgg_Description.japanese: まだほんのりあたたかい。

DuckMayonnaise_Description.japanese: 濃厚な黄色のマヨネーズ。

DwarfGadget_Description.japanese: かつてドワーフたちがつかっていた進んだ技術によってつくられた装置。画面はまだ点灯しつづけていて、起動しているような音も聞こえるが、つかい方はいぜんとして不明なまま。
DwarfGadget_Description.english: A device made with advanced technology once used by the dwarves. The screen is still lit, and a sound like it's running can be heard, but how to use it remains unknown.

DwarfScrollIII_Description.japanese: ドワーフ語で書かれている、羊皮紙製の黄ばんだ巻物。青いロープでとめてある。
DwarfScrollIII_Description.english: A yellowed parchment scroll written in the dwarf language. It's tied with a blue rope.

DwarfScrollII_Description.japanese: ドワーフ語で書かれている、羊皮紙製の黄ばんだ巻物。緑のリボンでとめてある。
DwarfScrollII_Description.english: A yellowed parchment scroll written in the dwarf language. It's tied with a green ribbon.

DwarfScrollIV_Description.japanese: ドワーフ語で書かれている、羊皮紙製の黄ばんだ巻物。金の鎖でとめてある。
DwarfScrollIV_Description.english: A yellowed parchment scroll written in the dwarf language. It's tied with a gold chain.

DwarfScrollI_Description.japanese: ドワーフ語で書かれている、羊皮紙製の黄ばんだ巻物。赤いリボンでとめてある。
DwarfScrollI_Description.english: A yellowed parchment scroll written in the dwarf language. It's tied with a red ribbon.

DwarvishHelm_Description.japanese: ドワーフたちにひろく着用されているカブト。ぶあつい金属のプレートが、落ちてくるものやしょうにゅう石から彼らを守る。
DwarvishHelm_Description.english: A helmet widely worn by dwarves. Thick metal plates protect them from falling objects and stalactites.

DwarvishTranslationGuide_Description.japanese: これがあればドワーフ語を学べる。
DwarvishTranslationGuide_Description.english: If you have this, you can learn the dwarf language.

EarthCrystal_Description.japanese: 地表の近くで見つかる樹脂質のかたまり。
EarthCrystal_Description.english: A resin-like lump found near the earth's surface.

Ectoplasm_Description.japanese: 魔術師がなぜか欲しがる、ドロドロでぬるぬるでべとべとしたもの。
Ectoplasm_Description.english: A thing that's gloopy, slimy, and sticky, which the Wizard wants for some reason.

Eel_Description.japanese: ほそ長い魚。ぬるぬるしている。
Eel_Description.english: A long, thin fish. It's slimy.

EggplantParmesan_Description.japanese: ピリ辛、チーズたっぷりなおいしさ。

EggplantSeeds_Description.japanese: 秋植えの作物。そだつのに5日かかる。最初の収穫のあともくりかえし収穫できる。
EggplantSeeds_Description.english: A fall-planted crop. Takes 5 days to grow. Can be harvested repeatedly after the first harvest.

Eggplant_Description.japanese: おいしくて健康にいいトマトの仲間。いためものやシチューにするとおいしい。
Eggplant_Description.english: A delicious and healthy relative of the tomato. Delicious as a stir-fry or stew.

ElvishJewelry_Description.japanese: うす汚れてなおうつくしい。側面には、古代のエルフたちがつかっていたと考えられる言葉が彫りこまれている。いまのところ、エルフたちの骨は見つかっていない。
ElvishJewelry_Description.english: Slightly grimy, yet still beautiful. On its side, words thought to have been used by ancient elves are carved. So far, no elf bones have been found.

EmeraldStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとエメラルドが手に入る。
EmeraldStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain emerald.

Emerald_Description.japanese: 緑色にかがやく貴重な宝石。
Emerald_Description.english: A precious gem that shines green.

EnergyTonic_Description.japanese: エネルギーを回復する。

Enricher_Description.japanese: スプリンクラーの上に置いて肥料を入れると、近くに種をまいた時に自動で施肥する。
Enricher_Description.english: Place it on a sprinkler and put fertilizer in, and when you sow seeds nearby it automatically applies fertilizer.

Escargot_Description.japanese: カタツムリをバターでカンペキにソテーした一皿。
Escargot_Description.english: A dish of snails perfectly sautéed in butter.

Esperite_Description.japanese: 刺激をあたえるとあざやかな緑にかがやく。
Esperite_Description.english: When given stimulation, it glows a vivid green.

ExplosiveAmmo_Description.japanese: パチンコにセットして撃ちだす。
ExplosiveAmmo_Description.english: Load it into a slingshot and fire it.

FairyDust_Description.japanese: 醸造ダル、加工設備、その他の精製装置にふりかけると、すぐに加工品を手に入れることができる。
FairyDust_Description.english: If sprinkled on a keg, processing equipment, or other refining device, you can immediately obtain the processed product.

FairyRose_Description.japanese: 古い伝承によると、この花のはなつあまい香りは妖精たちを惹きつけるのだという。
FairyRose_Description.english: According to old legend, the sweet scent this flower gives off attracts fairies.

FairySeeds_Description.japanese: 秋植えの花。12日かけて神秘的な花を咲かせる。色は咲いてのおたのしみ。
FairySeeds_Description.english: A fall-planted flower. Takes 12 days to bloom into a mysterious flower. The color is a surprise for when it blooms.

FairyStone_Description.japanese: 坑夫に伝わる古い歌のなかでは、この石は古代の妖精たちのホネからできたと言われている。
FairyStone_Description.english: In an old song passed down among miners, it's said this stone was made from the bones of ancient fairies.

FallSeeds_Description.japanese: 秋にとれる野草のタネのつめあわせ。
FallSeeds_Description.english: An assortment of wild-grass seeds gathered in autumn.

FarAwayStone_Description.japanese: 起源不明の石。何かの中に入れることができそうだ。
FarAwayStone_Description.english: A stone of unknown origin. It looks like it could be placed inside something.

FarmersLunch_Description.japanese: 腹が減っては仕事はできぬ。
FarmersLunch_Description.english: You can't work on an empty stomach (a play on the proverb 'you can't fight a war on an empty stomach').

FiberSeeds_Description.japanese: どの季節でも植えられる作物。水やりは必要ない。収穫にはカマが必要。育つのに7日かかる。
FiberSeeds_Description.english: A crop that can be planted in any season. Watering isn't necessary. A scythe is needed to harvest. Takes 7 days to grow.

FiddleheadFern_Description.japanese: 食べるとおいしい野草の若芽。ワラビの仲間。
FiddleheadFern_Description.english: A delicious young sprout of a wild grass, good to eat. A relative of bracken.

FiddleheadRisotto_Description.japanese: ソテーしたフィドルヘッドをそえたクリーミーなリゾット。ちょっと味気ない。
FiddleheadRisotto_Description.english: A creamy risotto accompanied by sautéed fiddleheads. A little bland.

FieldSnack_Description.japanese: 採集中のすばやいエネルギー補給に。
FieldSnack_Description.english: For quick energy replenishment while foraging.

FireOpal_Description.japanese: 珍しいオパールの亜種。炎のような赤い光のゆらめきが名の由来。
FireOpal_Description.english: A rare variety of opal. Its name comes from the flickering of its flame-like red light.

FireQuartz_Description.japanese: 赤くかがやく結晶。よく熱い溶岩のそばで見つかる。
FireQuartz_Description.english: A crystal that glows red. Often found near hot lava.

FireworksGreen_Description.japanese: お祝い事やお祭りでの風物詩。取り扱い注意！
FireworksGreen_Description.english: A traditional feature of celebrations and festivals. Handle with care!

FireworksPurple_Description.japanese: お祝い事やお祭りでの風物詩。取り扱い注意！
FireworksPurple_Description.english: A traditional feature of celebrations and festivals. Handle with care!

FireworksRed_Description.japanese: お祝い事やお祭りでの風物詩。取り扱い注意！
FireworksRed_Description.english: A traditional feature of celebrations and festivals. Handle with care!

FishStew_Description.japanese: まるで海のようなにおいがするが、味はおいしい。
FishStew_Description.english: It smells just like the sea, but it tastes delicious.

FishTaco_Description.japanese: おいしそうなにおいがする。

Flounder_Description.japanese: 海底に住んでいるので、両目が上側にあります。
Flounder_Description.english: Since it lives on the sea floor, both its eyes are on the upper side.

Fluorapatite_Description.japanese: この鉱物と同じ成分が、人間の歯にもちょっとふくまれている。
Fluorapatite_Description.english: The same component as this mineral is also contained a little in human teeth.

FluteBlock_Description.japanese: 上を歩くとフルートの音が鳴る。
FluteBlock_Description.english: A flute sound plays when you walk on top.

FossilStone_Description.japanese: 砕くと化石が手に入る。
FossilStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain fossils.

FossilizedRibs_Description.japanese: とても大きな動物の胴体を守っていたもの。
FossilizedRibs_Description.english: Something that protected the torso of a very large animal.

FossilizedSpine_Description.japanese: 骨が連なって柱状になったもの。
FossilizedSpine_Description.english: Bones linked in a row, forming a column shape.

FossilizedTail_Description.japanese: 先端がこん棒のような形をしている。
FossilizedTail_Description.english: The tip has a club-like shape.

FriedCalamari_Description.japanese: 肉厚の身は歯ごたえばつぐん。
FriedCalamari_Description.english: The thick flesh has an outstanding chewiness.

FriedEel_Description.japanese: 油っぽいが味はたしか。
FriedEel_Description.english: Oily, but the flavor is reliable.

FriedEgg_Description.japanese: 半熟の黄身はあざやかなイエロー。
FriedEgg_Description.english: The half-cooked yolk is a vivid yellow.

FriedMushroom_Description.japanese: キノコのうまみと香りがぎゅっとつまった一皿。
FriedMushroom_Description.english: A dish tightly packed with the umami and aroma of mushrooms.

FrozenGeodeStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとフローズンジオードが手に入る。
FrozenGeodeStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain frozen geodes.

FrozenGeode_Description.japanese: 鍛冶屋に持っていけば割ってもらえる。
FrozenGeode_Description.english: If you take it to a blacksmith, they'll break it open for you.

FrozenTear_Description.japanese: うつくしい結晶。言い伝えによると、イエティのなみだが凍ってできたのだという。
FrozenTear_Description.english: A beautiful crystal. According to legend, it's said to be formed from a yeti's frozen tears.

FruitSalad_Description.japanese: おいしい夏のくだものの盛りあわせ。
FruitSalad_Description.english: A delicious assortment of summer fruits.

GalaxySoul_Description.japanese: 3個使ってギャラクシー武器を鍛えると、その最終形態を解き放つ。
GalaxySoul_Description.english: Use 3 of these to forge a Galaxy weapon, and unleash its final form.

GarlicSeeds_Description.japanese: 春植えの作物。そだつのに4日かかる。
GarlicSeeds_Description.english: A spring-planted crop. Takes 4 days to grow.

Garlic_Description.japanese: その辛みと香りは料理の風味づけにぴったり。品質が高いほど辛みがつよくなる。
Garlic_Description.english: Its pungency and aroma are perfect for flavoring dishes. The higher the quality, the stronger the pungency.

Gate_Description.japanese: 柵に取りつければ外と中を行き来できる。
Gate_Description.english: If attached to a fence, you can pass between outside and inside.

GemStone_Description.japanese: 砕くと石、鉱石、ジオードなどが手に入る。
GemStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain stone, ore, geodes, and so on.

Geminite_Description.japanese: 鉱石が双子のように結晶したもの。良質な結晶群のなかにみられる。
Geminite_Description.english: Ore that has crystallized like twins. Seen within fine clusters of crystals.

GeodeStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとジオードが手に入る。
GeodeStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain geodes.

Geode_Description.japanese: 鍛冶屋に持っていけば割ってもらえる。
Geode_Description.english: If you take it to a blacksmith, they'll break it open for you.

GhostCrystal_Description.japanese: 結晶のまわりをひんやりしたオーラがとりまいている。
GhostCrystal_Description.english: A chilly aura surrounds this crystal.

Ghostfish_Description.japanese: 地下の湖に生息する青白い魚。目が退化している。
Ghostfish_Description.english: A pale blue-white fish that lives in underground lakes. Its eyes have degenerated.

GingerAle_Description.japanese: 刺激的な炭酸飲料。胃の調子を整えるらしい。
GingerAle_Description.english: A zesty carbonated drink. Said to settle the stomach.

Ginger_Description.japanese: ピリッとスパイシーな根っこ。食べると元気が出るらしい。
Ginger_Description.english: A sharp, spicy root. Said to give you energy when eaten.

GlacierfishJr_Description.japanese: 初代アイスフィッシュには息子がいた…
GlacierfishJr_Description.english: The original Ice Fish had a son...

Glacierfish_Description.japanese: 氷山の下に生息し、そこに巣をつくって暮らす魚。
Glacierfish_Description.english: A fish that lives beneath icebergs, building its nest there.

GlassShards_Description.japanese: 何世紀も海の波にさらされ、なめらかになったガラスのかけらたち。元は大むかしのモザイク画や首かざりだったのかもしれない。
GlassShards_Description.english: Glass fragments smoothed by centuries of ocean waves. They might have originally been an ancient mosaic or necklace.

segments.text: だったのかもしれない。

GlazedYams_Description.japanese: あまくてお腹も満足な一品。ミツはほんのりキャラメル風味。
GlazedYams_Description.english: A sweet, filling dish. The honey has a hint of caramel flavor.

GlowRing_Description.japanese: 明るい光でまわりを照らしてくれる。
GlowRing_Description.english: Illuminates the surroundings with a bright light.

GlowstoneRing_Description.japanese: 絶え間ない光を放っている。アイテムの収集範囲を広げる。
GlowstoneRing_Description.english: Emits a constant light. Widens your item-collection range.

GoatCheese_Description.japanese: ヤギのミルクでつくられたやわらかいチーズ。
GoatCheese_Description.english: A soft cheese made from goat's milk.

GoatMilk_Description.japanese: ヤギからとれるミルク。

Goby_Description.japanese: 種類によっては滝を登ることができる。
Goby_Description.english: Depending on the species, some can climb waterfalls.

GoldOre_Description.japanese: 貴重な鉱石。精錬してのべ棒にできる。
GoldOre_Description.english: A precious ore. Can be smelted into an ingot.

GoldStone_Description.japanese: 砕くと金鉱石が手に入る。
GoldStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain gold ore.

GoldenAnimalCracker_Description.japanese: 動物に与えると生産物がずっと2倍になる。ブタには効果がない。
GoldenAnimalCracker_Description.english: If given to an animal, its produce is permanently doubled. Has no effect on pigs.

GoldenBobber_Description.japanese: ウィリーがこれを探している。

GoldenCoconut_Description.japanese: とても硬くてなかなか割れない木の実の一種。専門家なら割ることができるかもしれない。
GoldenCoconut_Description.english: A type of nut that's so hard it's difficult to crack open. A professional might be able to break it.

segments.text: 割ることができるかもしれない。

GoldenEgg_Description.japanese: 金色の殻を持つ、とても珍しい特別なタマゴ。
GoldenEgg_Description.english: A very rare, special egg with a golden shell.

GoldenMask_Description.japanese: 気味の悪い黄金のマスク。魔術の儀式につかわれていたと見られている。目とひたいの位置には、おおきなむらさき色の宝石がはめこまれている。
GoldenMask_Description.english: An eerie golden mask. Thought to have been used in magical rituals. A large purple gem is set at the eyes and forehead.

GoldenPumpkin_Description.japanese: 高く売れるが、ほかにつかい道はないようだ。
GoldenPumpkin_Description.english: Sells for a lot, but doesn't seem to have any other use.

GoldenRelic_Description.japanese: 象形文字と絵が刻まれた、黄金のプレート。
GoldenRelic_Description.english: A golden plate engraved with hieroglyphs and pictures.

GoldenWalnut_Description.japanese: ジンジャーアイランドのオウムには最高のごちそう。
GoldenWalnut_Description.english: For the parrots of Ginger Island, this is the finest feast.

segments.text: ジンジャーアイランド

GourmetTomatoSalt_Description.japanese: 香りがよくおいしい塩。希少な品。
GourmetTomatoSalt_Description.english: A fragrant, delicious salt. A rare item.

Granite_Description.japanese: 鉱物のつぶがあつまってできた岩石。建築でよくつかわれている。
Granite_Description.english: A rock formed from gathered mineral grains. Often used in construction.

GrapeStarter_Description.japanese: 秋植えの作物。収穫まで10日かかるが、そのあともくりかえし収穫できる。支柱にからみながらそだつ。
GrapeStarter_Description.english: A fall-planted crop. Takes 10 days to harvest, but can be harvested repeatedly after that. Grows while twining around a trellis.

Grape_Description.japanese: たくさんの実がふさになったあまいくだもの。
Grape_Description.english: A sweet fruit with many berries in a cluster.

GrassBook_Description.japanese: 草むらや作物の中を速く走れるようになる。
GrassBook_Description.english: You become able to run faster through grassy areas and crops.

GrassStarter_Description.japanese: 牧場で牧草を育てるためのキット。植えれば牧草が生えてくる。
GrassStarter_Description.english: A kit for growing pasture grass on the ranch. If planted, pasture grass grows.

GravelPath_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して道をつくったり、地面を整えたりできる。
GravelPath_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

GreenBean_Description.japanese: 歯ごたえのいいサヤに包まれた、みずみずしいエンドウマメ。
GreenBean_Description.english: A juicy pea wrapped in a satisfyingly crunchy pod.

GreenRainWeeds_Description.japanese: せんいやミックスシードが混ざっていることがある。
GreenRainWeeds_Description.english: May contain fiber or mixed seeds mixed in.

GreenSlimeEgg_Description.japanese: スライム用ふ卵器でかえすことができる。
GreenSlimeEgg_Description.english: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.

GreenTea_Description.japanese: 軽く加工した茶葉から作られた心地よく活力のある飲みもの。
GreenTea_Description.english: A pleasant, energizing drink made from lightly processed tea leaves.

Halibut_Description.japanese: 海底に生息する平たい魚。ヒラメの仲間。
Halibut_Description.english: A flat fish that lives on the sea floor. A relative of the flounder.

HardwoodFence_Description.japanese: 柵のなかでは一番頑丈。

Hardwood_Description.japanese: 優れた強じんさとうつくしさをそなえたすばらしい木材。
Hardwood_Description.english: Wonderful lumber equipped with superior toughness and beauty.

Hashbrowns_Description.japanese: キツネ色でカリッとおいしい！

Hay_Description.japanese: ほした草。動物のエサになる。

Hazelnut_Description.japanese: とびきり大きいヘーゼルナッツ。

Hedge_Description.japanese: 柵のように使える低木。
Hedge_Description.english: A shrub that can be used like a fence.

Helvite_Description.japanese: 三角柱のかたちに結晶する鉱物。
Helvite_Description.english: A mineral that crystallizes in the shape of a triangular prism.

Hematite_Description.japanese: 主に鉄からなる鉱物。磁気をおびる興味ぶかい性質がある。
Hematite_Description.english: A mineral composed mainly of iron. Has the interesting property of carrying magnetism.

Herring_Description.english: A fish commonly seen in the sea.

Holly_Description.japanese: 赤い実をつける植物。葉にトゲがある。冬の飾りつけによくつかわれる。
Holly_Description.english: A plant that bears red berries. Its leaves have thorns. Often used for winter decoration.

Honey_Description.japanese: ミツバチがつくるあまいミツ。

HopsStarter_Description.japanese: 夏植えの作物。収穫まで11日かかるが、そのあともくりかえし収穫できる。支柱にからみながらそだつ。
HopsStarter_Description.english: A summer-planted crop. Takes 11 days to harvest, but can be harvested repeatedly after that. Grows while twining around a trellis.

Hops_Description.japanese: ビールの風味づけにつかわれる花。強い香りと苦みをもつ。
Hops_Description.english: A flower used to flavor beer. Has a strong aroma and bitterness.

HorseFlute_Description.japanese: このフルートを吹くと、馬を呼び寄せることができる。屋外で使用する。
HorseFlute_Description.english: If you blow this flute, you can call your horse to you. Used outdoors.

HotJavaRing_Description.japanese: モンスターを倒した時にコーヒーを発見する確率が大幅に上がる。
HotJavaRing_Description.english: Greatly raises the probability of finding coffee when you defeat a monster.

HotPepper_Description.japanese: 火が出るほど辛いが、ほのかなあまみもかくれている。
HotPepper_Description.english: Spicy enough to breathe fire, but a faint sweetness is also hidden within.

HyperSpeedGro_Description.japanese: 葉の成長を飛躍的に促す。作物の成長速度を少なくとも33%上げる。たがやした土に混ぜてつかう。
HyperSpeedGro_Description.english: Dramatically promotes leaf growth. Raises crop growth speed by at least 33%. Mix into tilled soil.

IceCream_Description.japanese: これがキライな人なんてそういないはず。
IceCream_Description.english: There surely aren't many people who dislike this.

IceCrystal_Description.japanese: 精錬クリスタルが手に入ることがある。

IcePip_Description.japanese: 極寒の環境でも生きていられる珍しい魚。
IcePip_Description.english: A rare fish that can live even in extremely cold environments.

ImmunityBand_Description.japanese: 上の部分がエンチャントされたパープルウールでできている。
ImmunityBand_Description.english: The top part is made from enchanted purple wool.

IridiumBand_Description.japanese: あたりを照らし、アイテムを引き寄せるほか、攻撃力を10%上げる。
IridiumBand_Description.english: Illuminates the surroundings, attracts items, and also raises attack power by 10%.

IridiumBar_Description.japanese: イリジウムでできたのべ棒

IridiumMilk_Description.japanese: 出どころ不明の強壮「ミルク」…

IridiumOre_Description.japanese: エキゾチックな鉱石。さまざまな興味ぶかい特性をもつほか、精錬してのべ棒にできる。
IridiumOre_Description.english: An exotic ore. Has various interesting properties, and can also be smelted into an ingot.

IridiumSprinkler_Description.japanese: となりあった周囲の24マスに毎朝水をやってくれる。
IridiumSprinkler_Description.english: Waters the surrounding 24 adjacent squares every morning.

IridiumStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとイリジウム鉱石が手に入る。
IridiumStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain iridium ore.

IronFence_Description.japanese: 石の柵よりながくもつ。
IronFence_Description.english: Lasts longer than a stone fence.

IronOre_Description.japanese: そこそこありふれた鉱石。精錬してのべ棒にできる。
IronOre_Description.english: A fairly common ore. Can be smelted into an ingot.

IronStone_Description.japanese: 砕くと鉄鉱石が手に入る。
IronStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain iron ore.

JackOLantern_Description.japanese: 風変わりな秋の飾りもの。

JadeRing_Description.japanese: クリティカル時のダメージ量が10%上がる。
JadeRing_Description.english: The damage amount on a critical hit rises by 10%.

JadeStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとヒスイが手に入る。
JadeStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain jade.

Jade_Description.japanese: うすい緑色の石。装飾につかわれる。
Jade_Description.english: A pale green stone. Used for decoration.

Jagoite_Description.japanese: とても細かな結晶がぎっしりあつまっているため、とてもキラキラして見える。
Jagoite_Description.english: Because very fine crystals are packed tightly together, it looks very sparkly.

Jamborite_Description.japanese: 細い結晶が密集しているため、まるで毛が生えたように見える。
Jamborite_Description.english: Because thin crystals are densely packed, it looks as if fur has grown on it.

Jasper_Description.japanese: 磨きあげると魅力的なかがやきをはなつ鉱石。数千年ものあいだ、人びとのあいだで珍重されてきた。
Jasper_Description.english: An ore that gives off an attractive shine when polished. Has been treasured among people for thousands of years.

JazzSeeds_Description.japanese: 春植えの花。7日かけてふわふわのボールのような花を咲かせる。
JazzSeeds_Description.english: A spring-planted flower. Takes 7 days to bloom into a fluffy ball-like flower.

JournalScrap_Description.japanese: 古い日記から破れたページ。湿ってボロボロになっている…
JournalScrap_Description.english: A page torn from an old diary. It's damp and tattered...

Juice_Description.japanese: あまくて栄養たっぷりな飲みもの。

JukeboxRing_Description.japanese: 聞いたことのあるミュージックをランダムで再生する。
JukeboxRing_Description.english: Randomly plays music you've heard before.

KaleSeeds_Description.japanese: 春植えの作物。そだつのに6日かかる。収穫にはカマが必要。
KaleSeeds_Description.english: A spring-planted crop. Takes 6 days to grow. A scythe is needed to harvest.

Kale_Description.japanese: つやつやした葉もの野菜。スープや野菜いためにぴったり。
Kale_Description.english: A glossy leafy vegetable. Perfect for soups and vegetable stir-fries.

Kyanite_Description.japanese: 整った結晶の表面は、まるでガラスのようになめらか。
Kyanite_Description.english: The surface of its well-ordered crystal is as smooth as glass.

LGoatMilk_Description.japanese: おおきなバケットに入ったヤギのミルク。
LGoatMilk_Description.english: Goat's milk in a large bucket.

LargeBrownEgg_Description.japanese: なかなかお目にかかれない、おおきくて茶色いタマゴ！
LargeBrownEgg_Description.english: A big, brown egg you don't often get to see!

LargeMilk_Description.japanese: おおきなバケットに入った牛のミルク。
LargeMilk_Description.english: Cow's milk in a large bucket.

LargeWhiteEgg_Description.japanese: なかなかお目にかかれない、おおきくて白いタマゴ！
LargeWhiteEgg_Description.english: A big, white egg you don't often get to see!

LargemouthBass_Description.japanese: 池や湖に生息する魚。釣り人に人気。
LargemouthBass_Description.english: A fish that lives in ponds and lakes. Popular among anglers.

LavaEel_Description.japanese: 真っ赤に溶けた溶岩のなかでも、なぜか生きられるらしい。
LavaEel_Description.english: Seems to be able to somehow live even inside bright red molten lava.

LeadBobber_Description.japanese: 釣りバーを安定させるおもり。バーがゲージの底にはねかえらなくなる。
LeadBobber_Description.english: A weight that stabilizes the 'fishing bar.' The bar no longer bounces off the bottom of the gauge.

Leek_Description.japanese: ネギの仲間。あまみがあっておいしい。
Leek_Description.english: A relative of the green onion. Sweet and delicious.

LegendII_Description.japanese: 初代レジェンドの後継者。

Legend_Description.japanese: 魚のなかの魚、これぞ魚の王！けっして釣りあげられないと言われてきた。
Legend_Description.english: The fish among fish, this is the king of fish! It's been said it can never be caught.

LemonStone_Description.japanese: この石の粉は、ドワーフたちにとってのごちそうだというウワサがある。
LemonStone_Description.english: There's a rumor that this stone's powder is a feast for the dwarves.

LifeElixir_Description.japanese: HPを満タンまで回復する。

Limestone_Description.japanese: とてもありふれた岩石。それほど価値は高くない。
Limestone_Description.english: A very common rock. Not worth all that much.

Lingcod_Description.japanese: 口に入れられるものは何でも食べてしまう、おそろしい捕食者。
Lingcod_Description.english: A fearsome predator that eats anything it can fit into its mouth.

Lionfish_Description.japanese: 攻撃的な肉食魚。毒のトゲを持っている。
Lionfish_Description.english: An aggressive carnivorous fish. Has poisonous spines.

LobsterBisque_Description.japanese: ウィリーの家に代々伝わるヒミツのスープ。絶妙な味がする。
LobsterBisque_Description.english: A secret soup passed down through generations in Willy's family. Has an exquisite taste.

Lobster_Description.japanese: 海をすみかとするおおきな甲殻類。しっぽの力は強烈。
Lobster_Description.english: A large crustacean whose home is the sea. Its tail's power is intense.

LostAxe_Description.japanese: ロビンがあちこち探しまわっていた、彼女のオノ。
LostAxe_Description.english: Robin's axe, which she was searching all over for.

LostBook_Description.japanese: いろいろな分野、さまざまな時代の本。
LostBook_Description.english: Books from various fields and various eras.

LuckyPurpleShorts_Description.japanese: くわしくはあまり聞かないほうがよさそう。
LuckyPurpleShorts_Description.english: It's probably better not to ask about the details.

LuckyRing_Description.japanese: 月の紋章は、身につける人に幸運をもたらすと言われている。
LuckyRing_Description.english: It's said the moon crest brings good luck to whoever wears it.

Lumber_Description.japanese: 建築や燃料など、いろいろな用途につかえる素材。
Lumber_Description.english: A material usable for various purposes, such as construction and fuel.

Lunarite_Description.japanese: 白い球状の結晶がかたまりになっている。
Lunarite_Description.english: White spherical crystals have formed into a cluster.

MagicBait_Description.japanese: これを使えば、どんな季節、時間、天候、水質でも魚を釣ることができる。
MagicBait_Description.english: If you use this, you can catch fish in any season, time, weather, or water quality.

MagicRockCandy_Description.japanese: 多彩なシャードのエッセンスを持つ希少で強力なキャンディ。
MagicRockCandy_Description.english: A rare and powerful candy that has the essence of the multicolored shard.

MagmaCap_Description.japanese: 溶岩湖のそばに生える珍しいキノコ。
MagmaCap_Description.english: A rare mushroom that grows beside lava lakes.

MagmaGeodeStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとマグマジオードが手に入る。
MagmaGeodeStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain magma geodes.

MagmaGeode_Description.japanese: 鍛冶屋に持っていけば割ってもらえる。
MagmaGeode_Description.english: If you take it to a blacksmith, they'll break it open for you.

MagnetRing_Description.japanese: アイテムをひろえる範囲が広くなる。
MagnetRing_Description.english: The range for picking up items becomes wider.

Magnet_Description.japanese: 釣りざおにセットすると、お宝のみつかる確率が上がる。しかしおいしくないせいか、魚はかかりづらくなる。
Magnet_Description.english: If set on a fishing rod, the probability of finding treasure rises. However, perhaps because it's not tasty, fish become harder to hook.

MahoganySeed_Description.japanese: 植えるとマホガニーの木が育つ。
MahoganySeed_Description.english: If planted, a mahogany tree grows.

MakiRoll_Description.japanese: 魚と米をのりで巻いたもの。
MakiRoll_Description.english: Fish and rice rolled in seaweed.

Malachite_Description.japanese: 装飾用としてポピュラーな石。緑の塗料や彫刻の材料としてつかわれる。
Malachite_Description.english: A stone popular for decoration. Used as material for green paint and sculpture.

MangoSapling_Description.japanese: 28日かけてマンゴーの成木になる。夏になるとマンゴーを実らせる。ジンジャーアイランドで育てると1年を通じて実をつける。
MangoSapling_Description.english: Takes 28 days to become a mature mango tree. Bears mangoes in summer. If grown on Ginger Island, it bears fruit all year round.

segments.text: ジンジャーアイランド

MangoStickyRice_Description.japanese: 甘いマンゴーとココナッツとお米を使った、とってもスペシャルな一品。
MangoStickyRice_Description.english: A very special dish using sweet mango, coconut, and rice.

Mango_Description.japanese: 大きくて甘いトロピカルフルーツ。独特の風味がある。
Mango_Description.english: A big, sweet tropical fruit. Has a distinctive flavor.

MapleBar_Description.japanese: 上にメープルシロップがかかったあま～いドーナツ。
MapleBar_Description.english: A sweeeet donut with maple syrup poured on top.

MapleSeed_Description.japanese: 植えるとカエデの木が育つ。
MapleSeed_Description.english: If planted, a maple tree grows.

MapleSyrup_Description.japanese: 独特の風味をもつあまいシロップ。
MapleSyrup_Description.english: A sweet syrup with a distinctive flavor.

Marble_Description.japanese: 彫刻や建築の素材としてよく使われる岩石。
Marble_Description.english: A rock often used as material for sculpture and construction.

Mayonnaise_Description.japanese: パンにぬって食べるのがおすすめ。
Mayonnaise_Description.english: Recommended to eat spread on bread.

Mead_Description.japanese: ハチミツを発酵させたお酒。飲むときはほどほどに。
Mead_Description.english: An alcohol made by fermenting honey. Drink in moderation.

MegaBomb_Description.japanese: 強力な爆発を起こす。つかうには細心の注意が必要。
MegaBomb_Description.english: Causes a powerful explosion. Requires the utmost care to use.

MelonSeeds_Description.japanese: 夏植えの作物。そだつのに12日かかる。
MelonSeeds_Description.english: A summer-planted crop. Takes 12 days to grow.

Melon_Description.japanese: ひんやりあまい夏のごちそう。

MermaidsPendant_Description.japanese: 結婚したい人にこれを渡そう。
MermaidsPendant_Description.english: Give this to the person you want to marry.

MidnightCarp_Description.japanese: この魚は夜だけ快適に感じる。
MidnightCarp_Description.english: This fish only feels comfortable at night.

MidnightSquid_Description.japanese: ゆらめく海の奥底にいる奇妙な謎の生物
MidnightSquid_Description.english: A strange, mysterious creature that lives in the shimmering depths of the sea.

Milk_Description.japanese: バケット一杯ぶんのウシのミルク。
Milk_Description.english: A bucket full of cow's milk.

MinersTreat_Description.japanese: 採掘のときのエネルギー補給に。

MixedFlowerSeeds_Description.japanese: いろんな花のタネが混ざりあっている。植えてみて、なにがそだつか見てみよう！
MixedFlowerSeeds_Description.english: Seeds of various flowers are mixed together. Try planting them and see what grows!

MixedSeeds_Description.japanese: いろんなタネが混じりあっている。植えてみて、なにがそだつか見てみよう！
MixedSeeds_Description.english: Various seeds are mixed together. Try planting them and see what grows!

MonsterMusk_Description.japanese: これをスプレーすると、隠れているモンスターを引き寄せることができる。
MonsterMusk_Description.english: If you spray this, you can draw out hidden monsters.

Morel_Description.japanese: 独特のかぐわしい香りゆえに珍重されるキノコ。
Morel_Description.english: A mushroom treasured for its distinctive fragrant aroma.

MossSoup_Description.japanese: とろみがあってぬるぬるしているが、食べられる。
MossSoup_Description.english: It's thick and slimy, but edible.

Moss_Description.japanese: 日陰で育つ特殊な植物。
Moss_Description.english: A special plant that grows in shade.

MossySeed_Description.japanese: 植えると珍しい野生の木が育つ。
MossySeed_Description.english: If planted, a rare wild tree grows.

MovieTicket_Description.japanese: 映画館への入場を認めます。これを友人に渡すと、一緒に映画に招待します。
MovieTicket_Description.english: Grants admission to the movie theater. If you give this to a friend, you invite them to the movie with you.

MsAngler_Description.japanese: 獲物をおびき寄せるために、生物発光する突起を使う。
MsAngler_Description.english: Uses a bioluminescent projection to lure prey.

Mudstone_Description.japanese: 大むかしの粘土や泥が固まってできた、きめの細かい岩石。
Mudstone_Description.english: A fine-grained rock formed from ancient clay or mud hardening.

MummifiedBat_Description.japanese: 細かな羽根も完全に残っている。
MummifiedBat_Description.english: Even its delicate wings remain perfectly intact.

MummifiedFrog_Description.japanese: この古代のカエルは、ジャングルの上で暮らしていたのかもしれない。
MummifiedFrog_Description.english: This ancient frog might have lived up in the jungle canopy.

MuscleRemedy_Description.japanese: はたらきすぎたときはこれを飲もう。「疲れ」を吹き飛ばしてくれる。
MuscleRemedy_Description.english: Drink this when you've worked too much. It blows away 'Exhaustion.'

MushroomTreeSeed_Description.japanese: 農場に植えるとキノコの木が育つ。
MushroomTreeSeed_Description.english: If planted on the farm, a mushroom tree grows.

MusselStone_Description.japanese: 中にムールガイが入っている。

Mussel_Description.japanese: よく目につく2枚貝。ときどき、集団でかたまっていることがある。
Mussel_Description.english: A bivalve that's easy to spot. Sometimes found clustered in groups.

MutantCarp_Description.japanese: 下水道に流れるおかしな水が、ふつうのコイを化けものに変えてしまった。
MutantCarp_Description.english: Strange water flowing through the sewer turned an ordinary carp into a monster.

MysteryBox_Description.japanese: 鍛冶屋に持っていけば開けてもらえる。中に何が入っているかは誰にもわからない。
MysteryBox_Description.english: If you take it to a blacksmith, they'll open it for you. Nobody knows what's inside.

MysticStone_Description.japanese: 砕くと石、鉱石、ジオードなどが手に入る。
MysticStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain stone, ore, geodes, and so on.

MysticSyrup_Description.japanese: 魔法の効果があると言われている、とても珍しいシロップ。
MysticSyrup_Description.english: A very rare syrup said to have magical effects.

MysticTreeSeed_Description.japanese: 植えると特別な木が育つ。
MysticTreeSeed_Description.english: If planted, a special tree grows.

NapalmRing_Description.japanese: 敵を倒すときに爆発します。
NapalmRing_Description.english: It explodes when you defeat an enemy.

NautilusFossil_Description.japanese: 古代のサンゴ礁に生息していたアンモナイトが、長い時をへて貝がらだけになったもの。
NautilusFossil_Description.english: An ammonite that lived in an ancient coral reef, which over a long time became just a shell.

Nekoite_Description.japanese: 小さくかぼそいピンクの結晶が密集して毛のようになっている。
Nekoite_Description.english: Small, delicate pink crystals are densely packed together, looking like fur.

Neptunite_Description.japanese: つややかさがきわだつ漆黒の鉱石。
Neptunite_Description.english: A jet-black ore notable for its glossy sheen.

OakResin_Description.japanese: オークの樹液からとれる、いい香りのべとべとした物質。
OakResin_Description.english: A good-smelling, sticky substance obtained from oak sap.

Obsidian_Description.japanese: 溶岩が急速に冷えてできるガラス質の火山岩。
Obsidian_Description.english: A glassy volcanic rock formed when lava cools rapidly.

OceanStone_Description.japanese: 人魚たちがつくったモザイク画が石になったものだという伝説が伝わっている。
OceanStone_Description.english: There's a legend passed down that this is a mosaic made by mermaids that turned to stone.

Octopus_Description.japanese: ミステリアスな海の生きもの。知能が高い。
Octopus_Description.english: A mysterious sea creature. Highly intelligent.

Oil_Description.japanese: なんにでもつかえる食用油。
Oil_Description.english: Cooking oil that can be used for anything.

OilofGarlic_Description.japanese: これを飲めば、弱いモンスターは近づいてこなくなる。
OilofGarlic_Description.english: If you drink this, weak monsters will no longer approach.

OmniGeodeStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとオムニジオードが手に入る。
OmniGeodeStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain omni geodes.

OmniGeode_Description.japanese: 鍛冶屋に持っていけば割ってもらえる。なかには珍しい鉱石が入っているかも。
OmniGeode_Description.english: If you take it to a blacksmith, they'll break it open for you. A rare ore might be inside.

Opal_Description.japanese: 内部の構造が、受けた光を虹色にして跳ねかえしている。
Opal_Description.english: Its internal structure bounces back received light as a rainbow.

OrangeSapling_Description.japanese: 28日かけて成木にそだち、夏になるとくだものを実らせる。となりあった周囲の「8マス」が空いていないとそだたない。
OrangeSapling_Description.english: Takes 28 days to grow into a mature tree, and bears fruit in summer. Won't grow unless the surrounding '8 squares' are empty.

Orange_Description.japanese: 果汁たっぷりであまずっぱい、夏らしい香りをふりまくくだもの。
Orange_Description.english: A fruit full of juice, sweet-and-sour, that spreads a summery aroma.

OrnamentalFan_Description.japanese: 高貴な女性が持っていたと思われる洗練された扇。歴史家たちによると、この谷は第6時代に裕福な人びとのあいだで旅行地として人気があったらしい。
OrnamentalFan_Description.english: A refined fan thought to have been held by a noblewoman. According to historians, this valley was apparently popular as a travel destination among wealthy people in the 6th Age.

OrnateNecklace_Description.japanese: バスハウスの外で水面に浮かぶ派手なネックレス。まだ濡れています...
OrnateNecklace_Description.english: A flashy necklace found floating on the water's surface outside the bath house. It's still wet...

Orpiment_Description.japanese: 猛毒のヒ素をふくんでいるが、その高い毒性にもかかわらず、製造業や民間療法でひろく利用されている。
Orpiment_Description.english: Contains highly toxic arsenic, but despite its high toxicity, is widely used in manufacturing and folk remedies.

OstrichEgg_Description.japanese: 世界最大の卵かもしれない。
OstrichEgg_Description.english: It might be the world's largest egg.

Oyster_Description.japanese: 海水をこしとってエサを探す。その過程で水中の有害な物質を取りのぞいてくれていることがわかっている。
Oyster_Description.english: Filters seawater to find food. In the process, it's known to remove harmful substances from the water.

segments.text: 取りのぞいてくれている

PaleBroth_Description.japanese: 上品な味のスープ。ちょっぴりイオウの香りがする。
PaleBroth_Description.english: An elegant-tasting soup. Has a slight smell of sulfur.

PalmFossil_Description.japanese: ヤシの化石自体はよくみつかるが、ここまで保存状態がいい標本はなかなかない。
PalmFossil_Description.english: Palm fossils themselves are commonly found, but a specimen this well-preserved is quite rare.

Pancakes_Description.japanese: 2枚にかさねたフワフワのパンケーキ。

ParsnipSeeds_Description.japanese: 春植えの作物。そだつのに4日かかる。
ParsnipSeeds_Description.english: A spring-planted crop. Takes 4 days to grow.

ParsnipSoup_Description.japanese: みずみずしくてヘルシーなスープ。

Parsnip_Description.japanese: 春が旬の根菜で、ニンジンの親せき。栄養たっぷりで、かじると大地の味がする。
Parsnip_Description.english: A root vegetable in season in spring, a relative of the carrot. Full of nutrition, and tastes of the earth when bitten into.

PeachSapling_Description.japanese: 28日かけて成木にそだち、夏になるとくだものを実らせる。となりあった周囲の「8マス」が空いていないとそだたない。
PeachSapling_Description.english: Takes 28 days to grow into a mature tree, and bears fruit in summer. Won't grow unless the surrounding '8 squares' are empty.

Peach_Description.japanese: うぶげに表面がおおわれたくだもの。
Peach_Description.english: A fruit whose surface is covered in fine down.

Pearl_Description.japanese: 海からの希少な贈り物。
Pearl_Description.english: A rare gift from the sea.

PepperPoppers_Description.japanese: トウガラシにチーズをつめ、パン粉をまぶして揚げたもの。
PepperPoppers_Description.english: Chili peppers stuffed with cheese, coated in breadcrumbs, and fried.

PepperSeeds_Description.japanese: 夏植えの作物。そだつのに5日かかる。最初の収穫のあともくりかえし収穫できる。
PepperSeeds_Description.english: A summer-planted crop. Takes 5 days to grow. Can be harvested repeatedly after the first harvest.

Perch_Description.japanese: 冬にすがたを見せる淡水魚。
Perch_Description.english: A freshwater fish that shows itself in winter.

Periwinkle_Description.japanese: 淡水に生息する、小さなカタツムリの仲間。青いカラにすんでいる。
Periwinkle_Description.english: A small relative of the snail that lives in fresh water. Lives in a blue shell.

PetLicense_Description.japanese: 新しいペットを家に迎えよう。外に置いてあるペット用ボウルの数が足りないとペットは不機嫌になってしまう。
PetLicense_Description.english: Welcome a new pet into your home. If there aren't enough pet bowls placed outside, the pet becomes ill-tempered.

PetrifiedSlime_Description.japanese: こんなに小さいが、推定年齢は100000歳。
PetrifiedSlime_Description.english: Even though it's this small, its estimated age is 100,000 years.

PhoenixRing_Description.japanese: 1日に1度、戦闘でノックアウトされた時に体力を回復する。
PhoenixRing_Description.english: Once per day, restores health when knocked out in combat.

Pickles_Description.japanese: 自家製ピクルスのビンづめ。

PierresMissingStocklist_Description.japanese: ピエールが興味を示すかもしれない。
PierresMissingStocklist_Description.english: Pierre might show interest in this.

Pike_Description.japanese: 手ごわい淡水魚。釣り上げるのはむずかしい。
Pike_Description.english: A formidable freshwater fish. Difficult to reel in.

PineCone_Description.japanese: 植えるとマツの木が育つ。
PineCone_Description.english: If planted, a pine tree grows.

PineTar_Description.japanese: マツの樹液からとれる物質。つよいマツの香りが鼻をつく。
PineTar_Description.english: A substance obtained from pine sap. Has a strong pine scent that hits the nose.

PineappleSeeds_Description.japanese: 温暖な気候で育つ作物。成熟するのに14日かかる。その後も実をつける。
PineappleSeeds_Description.english: A crop that grows in warm climates. Takes 14 days to mature. Continues to bear fruit after that.

Pineapple_Description.japanese: 甘さと酸味があるトロピカルスイーツ。
Pineapple_Description.english: A tropical treat with sweetness and tartness.

PinkCake_Description.japanese: てっぺんには小さなハートのキャンディが乗っかっている。
PinkCake_Description.english: Small heart-shaped candies are placed on top.

PiratesLocket_Description.japanese: かつての海賊の思い出の品。
PiratesLocket_Description.english: A keepsake of a pirate from long ago.

Pizza_Description.japanese: だれもが好きな永遠のベストレシピ。
Pizza_Description.english: An eternal best recipe that everyone likes.

PlumPudding_Description.japanese: 伝統的な祝日のデザート。

Poi_Description.japanese: 生で食べるとほのかに甘い、伝統的な食べ物。
Poi_Description.english: A traditional food that's faintly sweet when eaten raw.

PomegranateSapling_Description.japanese: 28日かけて成木にそだち、秋になるとくだものを実らせる。となりあった周囲の「8マス」が空いていないとそだたない。
PomegranateSapling_Description.english: Takes 28 days to grow into a mature tree, and bears fruit in fall. Won't grow unless the surrounding '8 squares' are empty.

Pomegranate_Description.japanese: ジューシーな粒がなかにぎっしりつまったくだもの。
Pomegranate_Description.english: A fruit tightly packed inside with juicy grains.

PoppySeeds_Description.japanese: 夏植えの花。7日かけてあざやかな赤い花を咲かせる。
PoppySeeds_Description.english: A summer-planted flower. Takes 7 days to bloom into a vivid red flower.

Poppy_Description.japanese: いろとりどりの花をさかせるほか、食用や医療用としても利用される植物。
Poppy_Description.english: A plant that, besides blooming into colorful flowers, is also used for food and medicine.

PoppyseedMuffin_Description.japanese: 食べると気もちが落ちつく。

PotatoSeeds_Description.japanese: 春植えの作物。そだつのに6日かかる。収穫のとき、追加でいくつか収穫できることがある。
PotatoSeeds_Description.english: A spring-planted crop. Takes 6 days to grow. At harvest, you may be able to harvest a few extra.

Potato_Description.japanese: ひろく栽培されているイモ類。

PowdermelonSeeds_Description.japanese: 冬に育つ特別なメロン。そだつのに7日かかる。
PowdermelonSeeds_Description.english: A special melon that grows in winter. Takes 7 days to grow.

Powdermelon_Description.japanese: 粉をふりかけたような皮を持つメロン。さわやかな甘みがある。
Powdermelon_Description.english: A melon whose skin looks as if powder has been sprinkled on it. Has a refreshing sweetness.

PrehistoricHandaxe_Description.japanese: 人類が使っていたどうぐのなかでも初期のもの。この「粗野な」どうぐは、石で石をくだき、鋭く加工することによってつくられていた。
PrehistoricHandaxe_Description.english: One of the earliest tools used by humankind. This 'crude' tool was made by striking stone against stone to sharpen it.

PrehistoricRib_Description.japanese: 側面に小さなキズがついているところをみると、ホネの持ち主はだれかのディナーになったようだ。
PrehistoricRib_Description.english: Judging from the small marks on its side, it seems the bone's owner became someone's dinner.

PrehistoricScapula_Description.japanese: 「つばさのなごり」と呼ばれることもある肩につながるホネ…だが、どの動物のものなのかは不明。
PrehistoricScapula_Description.english: A bone connected to the shoulder, sometimes called a 'remnant of a wing'... but which animal it belonged to is unknown.

PrehistoricTibia_Description.japanese: 太くてがんじょうな脚のホネ。

PrehistoricTool_Description.japanese: 粗野なつくりの古い道具。土を掘るのにつかわれていたようだ。
PrehistoricTool_Description.english: A crudely made old tool. Seems to have been used for digging earth.

PrehistoricVertebra_Description.japanese: 有史前に生きていた動物の背骨の一部。
PrehistoricVertebra_Description.english: Part of the spine of an animal that lived in prehistoric times.

PressureNozzle_Description.japanese: スプリンクラーの上に置くと、水やりの範囲が広がる。
PressureNozzle_Description.english: If placed on a sprinkler, its watering range expands.

PrismaticJelly_Description.japanese: 希少で捕まえにくいプリズムスライムから採れる。
PrismaticJelly_Description.english: Obtained from the rare, hard-to-catch prism slime.

PrismaticShard_Description.japanese: とてつもなく貴重でパワフルな物質。その起源はナゾにつつまれている。
PrismaticShard_Description.english: An extraordinarily precious and powerful substance. Its origin is shrouded in mystery.

PrizeTicket_Description.japanese: ルイスの家にある賞品マシーンで特別な賞品アイテムと交換できる。
PrizeTicket_Description.english: Can be exchanged for a special prize item at the prize machine in Lewis's house.

ProtectionRing_Description.japanese: ダメージを受けるとしばらく無敵状態になる。
ProtectionRing_Description.english: Once you take damage, you become invincible for a while.

Pufferfish_Description.japanese: 身の危険を感じるとからだをふくらませる。
Pufferfish_Description.english: Inflates its body when it senses danger.

PumpkinPie_Description.japanese: パイ生地になめらかカボチャクリームがつまっている。
PumpkinPie_Description.english: Smooth pumpkin cream is packed into a pie crust.

PumpkinSeeds_Description.japanese: 秋植えの作物。そだつのに13日かかる。
PumpkinSeeds_Description.english: A fall-planted crop. Takes 13 days to grow.

Pumpkin_Description.japanese: 秋野菜の代表格。栄養のつまったタネと風味のいい果肉がついた実をみのらせる。中身をくりぬいて、外側の皮をお祭りの飾りものとしてつかうこともある。
Pumpkin_Description.english: A representative fall vegetable. Bears a fruit with nutrient-packed seeds and flavorful flesh. Sometimes the inside is hollowed out and the outer skin used as a festival decoration.

PurpleBook_Description.japanese: これを読んですべてスキルの経験を積もう。
PurpleBook_Description.english: Read this and gain experience in all skills.

PurpleMushroom_Description.japanese: めずらしいキノコ。洞窟の深いところに生える。
PurpleMushroom_Description.english: A rare mushroom. Grows deep in caves.

PurpleSlimeEgg_Description.japanese: スライム用ふ卵器でかえすことができる。
PurpleSlimeEgg_Description.english: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.

Pyrite_Description.japanese: 見かけが金に似ているため、「愚か者の金」として知られる。
Pyrite_Description.english: Because its appearance resembles gold, it's known as 'fool's gold.'

QiBean_Description.japanese: どの季節でも植えられる作物。毎日水やりをしてQiフルーツを育てよう。そだつのに4日かかる。
QiBean_Description.english: A crop that can be planted in any season. Water it every day to grow a Qi Fruit. Takes 4 days to grow.

QiFruit_Description.japanese: ミスターQiはこの不思議なメロンを500個出荷させようとしている。
QiFruit_Description.english: Mr. Qi is trying to have you ship 500 of this mysterious melon.

segments.text: 出荷させようとしている。
segments.gloss: is trying to have you ship

QiGem_Description.japanese: ミスターQiの誉れ高い特別な通貨。

QiSeasoning_Description.japanese: ほんのひと振りでどんな料理も格別な一品に。調理時に自動で添加される。
QiSeasoning_Description.english: Just one shake turns any dish into something exceptional. Automatically added during cooking.

QualityBobber_Description.japanese: 釣れる魚の品質が良くなる。
QualityBobber_Description.english: Improves the quality of fish you catch.

QualityFertilizer_Description.japanese: 土の質をよくして、高品質な作物ができる確率をぐっと上げる。たがやした土に混ぜてつかう。
QualityFertilizer_Description.english: Improves soil quality, considerably raising the chance of growing high-quality crops. Mix into tilled soil.

QualityRetainingSoil_Description.japanese: 土の保水力を上げ、次の日まで湿りけを保っていられる確率をぐっと上げる。たがやした土に混ぜてつかう。
QualityRetainingSoil_Description.english: Raises the soil's water-retention, considerably raising the chance it stays moist until the next day. Mix into tilled soil.

QualitySprinkler_Description.japanese: となりあった周囲の8マスに毎朝水をやってくれる。
QualitySprinkler_Description.english: Waters the surrounding 8 adjacent squares every morning.

Quartz_Description.japanese: 洞窟や鉱山でよく見つかるすきとおった結晶。
Quartz_Description.english: A transparent crystal often found in caves and mines.

RabbitsFoot_Description.japanese: 幸運のお守りと言われている。
RabbitsFoot_Description.english: Said to be a good-luck charm.

RadioactiveBar_Description.japanese: 取り返しのつかない身体的被害を引き起こすことが、ズズシティの安全委員会で判明している。
RadioactiveBar_Description.english: Determined by the Zuzu City Safety Commission to cause irreversible bodily harm.

RadioactiveCarp_Description.japanese: 有毒なヘドロの中で長い年月を過ごしたコイ。
RadioactiveCarp_Description.english: A carp that spent many years in toxic sludge.

RadioactiveOre_Description.japanese: 危険なエネルギーで輝いている…精錬してのべ棒にできる。
RadioactiveOre_Description.english: It's glowing with dangerous energy... Can be smelted into an ingot.

RadioactiveStone_Description.japanese: 放射性の鉱石を含んでいる。

RadishSalad_Description.japanese: パリパリラディッシュをめしあがれ！

RadishSeeds_Description.japanese: 夏植えの作物。そだつのに6日かかる。
RadishSeeds_Description.english: A summer-planted crop. Takes 6 days to grow.

Radish_Description.japanese: パリっとさわやかな根菜。生でかじるとピリッとからい。
Radish_Description.english: A crisp, refreshing root vegetable. Sharp and spicy when bitten raw.

RainTotem_Description.japanese: つかうと、明日雨のふる確率がぐんとあがる。一度つかうとなくなる。
RainTotem_Description.english: If used, the probability of rain tomorrow rises considerably. Disappears once used.

RainbowShell_Description.japanese: とてもうつくしい貝がら。

RainbowTrout_Description.japanese: カラフルな模様がある淡水魚。
RainbowTrout_Description.english: A freshwater fish with colorful markings.

Raisins_Description.japanese: ジュニモたちの大好物だと言われている。
Raisins_Description.english: Said to be the Junimos' favorite food.

RareDisc_Description.japanese: 風変わりな赤い石があしらわれている、ずっしりと重く黒い円盤。手に持つと、底知れない恐怖に圧倒される。
RareDisc_Description.english: A heavy, black disc adorned with peculiar red stones. When held in the hand, one is overwhelmed by an unfathomable dread.

RareSeed_Description.japanese: 秋植えの作物。そだつのに1シーズンかかる。
RareSeed_Description.english: A fall-planted crop. Takes one whole season to grow.

RedCabbageSeeds_Description.japanese: 夏植えの作物。そだつのに9日かかる。
RedCabbageSeeds_Description.english: A summer-planted crop. Takes 9 days to grow.

RedCabbage_Description.japanese: サラダやコールスローでよくつかわれる。土の状態によって、葉の色はむらさき色から青、きみどりにまで変化する。
RedCabbage_Description.english: Often used in salad and coleslaw. Depending on soil conditions, the leaf color can range from purple to blue to yellow-green.

RedMullet_Description.japanese: かつては観賞用として飼われていた魚。
RedMullet_Description.english: A fish once kept as an ornamental pet.

RedMushroom_Description.japanese: 白い水玉もようのキノコ。洞窟でときどき見つかる。
RedMushroom_Description.english: A mushroom with a white polka-dot pattern. Sometimes found in caves.

RedPlate_Description.japanese: アンチエイジングに効果的。

RedSlimeEgg_Description.japanese: スライム用ふ卵器でかえすことができる。
RedSlimeEgg_Description.english: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.

RedSnapper_Description.japanese: あざやかな赤い魚。食用として人気が高い。
RedSnapper_Description.english: A vividly red fish. Very popular as food.

RhubarbPie_Description.japanese: あまいなかにも酸味のきいたおいしいパイ。
RhubarbPie_Description.english: A delicious pie that, even amid sweetness, has a good tartness.

RhubarbSeeds_Description.japanese: 春植えの作物。そだつのに13日かかる。
RhubarbSeeds_Description.english: A spring-planted crop. Takes 13 days to grow.

Rhubarb_Description.japanese: 茎を食べる。味はとてもすっぱいが、砂糖で煮ればすばらしいデザートになる。
Rhubarb_Description.english: You eat the stalk. The taste is very sour, but if simmered with sugar it becomes a wonderful dessert.

RicePudding_Description.japanese: クリーミーでスイートなおいしいおやつ。

RiceShoot_Description.japanese: 春植えの作物。そだつのに8日かかる。水域の近くに植えると成長が早くなります。収穫にはカマが必要。
RiceShoot_Description.english: A spring-planted crop. Takes 8 days to grow. Grows faster if planted near a body of water. A scythe is needed to harvest.

Rice_Description.japanese: 水田で栽培される穀物。ときどき野菜にそえられて出てくる。
Rice_Description.english: A grain cultivated in paddy fields. Sometimes served alongside vegetables.

RingofYoba_Description.japanese: ときどきダメージをふせいでくれるシールドを張る。
RingofYoba_Description.english: Sometimes puts up a shield that blocks damage.

RiverJelly_Description.japanese: 淡水で見つかる珍しいゼリー
RiverJelly_Description.english: A rare jelly found in fresh water.

RoastedHazelnuts_Description.japanese: ローストしたことで、ナッツの濃厚な風味が引き出されている。
RoastedHazelnuts_Description.english: Roasting has drawn out the nut's rich flavor.

Roe_Description.japanese: 鮮魚の卵。風味を引き出すために保存ジャーの中で熟成させることができる。
Roe_Description.english: Eggs of a fresh fish. Can be aged inside a preserving jar to draw out its flavor.

RootsPlatter_Description.japanese: 食べると力がわいてくる。
RootsPlatter_Description.english: Eating it makes strength well up.

RottenPlant_Description.japanese: 分解されかかっている有機物。ぬるぬるしていて気もち悪い。
RottenPlant_Description.english: Organic matter in the process of decomposing. It's slimy and unpleasant.

segments.text: 分解されかかっている

RubyStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとルビーが手に入る。
RubyStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain ruby.

Ruby_Description.japanese: 深い紅色とうつくしい輝きが珍重される貴重な宝石。
Ruby_Description.english: A precious gem treasured for its deep crimson color and beautiful shine.

RusticPlankFloor_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して、道をつくったり地面を整えたりできる。
RusticPlankFloor_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.
