RustyCog_Description.japanese: 大むかしの装置につかわれていたと思われる、保存状態がいい歯車。ドワーフの技術に関係するものだと考えられている。
RustyCog_Description.english: A well-preserved gear thought to have been used in an ancient device. Believed to be related to dwarf technology.

RustySpoon_Description.japanese: 10年くらい埋まっていたと思われる、ふつうの古いスプーン。たいして価値はない。
RustySpoon_Description.english: An ordinary old spoon that seems to have been buried for about 10 years. Not worth much.

RustySpur_Description.japanese: かつてはカウボーイのブーツにとりつけられていた古い拍車。この谷に住む人びとが、何世代も前から動物をそだてつづけてきた証拠。
RustySpur_Description.english: An old spur once attached to a cowboy's boot. Proof that the people living in this valley have continued raising animals for many generations.

Salad_Description.japanese: ヘルシーなグリーンサラダ。

SalmonDinner_Description.japanese: しあげにレモンをしぼると絶品。
SalmonDinner_Description.english: Squeezing lemon on it as a finishing touch makes it exquisite.

Salmon_Description.japanese: タマゴをうむために川をさかのぼることで知られる。
Salmon_Description.english: Known for swimming upstream to lay eggs.

Salmonberry_Description.japanese: 森の香りがする春のベリー。
Salmonberry_Description.english: A spring berry with the scent of the forest.

Sandfish_Description.japanese: 砂にまぎれて身をかくす習性をもつ。
Sandfish_Description.english: Has a habit of hiding its body by blending into the sand.

Sandstone_Description.japanese: ありふれた岩石。赤と茶色のしまが入っている。
Sandstone_Description.english: A common rock. Has red and brown stripes.

Sap_Description.japanese: 木のなかを流れている液体。
Sap_Description.english: A liquid that flows within a tree.

Sardine_Description.english: A fish commonly seen in the sea.

Sashimi_Description.japanese: 生の魚をスライスしただけの料理。
Sashimi_Description.english: A dish that's just raw fish sliced.

SavageRing_Description.japanese: モンスターを倒すごとに、ちょっとだけスピードブーストがつく。
SavageRing_Description.english: Every time you defeat a monster, you get a little speed boost.

ScorpionCarp_Description.japanese: 一見ふつうのコイだが、鋭いトゲを持っている。
ScorpionCarp_Description.english: At a glance, an ordinary carp, but it has a sharp barb.

SeaCucumber_Description.japanese: ぬるぬるしてつかみにくい海の生きもの。海底に生息している。
SeaCucumber_Description.english: A slimy sea creature that's hard to grip. Lives on the sea floor.

SeaJelly_Description.japanese: 海で見つかる珍しいゼリー
SeaJelly_Description.english: A rare jelly found in the sea.

SeaUrchin_Description.japanese: トゲだらけの動きがにぶい生きもの。高級食材としてあつかう人もいる。
SeaUrchin_Description.english: A spine-covered, slow-moving creature. Some people treat it as a luxury ingredient.

SeafoamPudding_Description.japanese: このブリニープリンは、本当にあなたを海洋の考え方に導いてくれます！
SeafoamPudding_Description.english: This briny pudding truly leads you into a maritime mindset!

Seaweed_Description.japanese: 食材として利用できる。
Seaweed_Description.english: Can be used as a cooking ingredient.

SecretNote_Description.japanese: しわくちゃでボロボロだが、よーく目を凝らせば内容がわかるはず…
SecretNote_Description.english: It's wrinkled and tattered, but if you look very closely, you should be able to make out its contents...

Shad_Description.japanese: 海で成長するが、産卵の時期には生まれた川にもどってくる。
Shad_Description.english: Grows in the sea, but returns to the river where it was born at spawning time.

ShrimpCocktail_Description.japanese: 獲れたてのエビを使った豪華な前菜。
ShrimpCocktail_Description.english: A luxurious appetizer using freshly caught shrimp.

Shrimp_Description.japanese: 海底にすむ海のそうじ屋。そのおいしさから、いろんな国で親しまれている。
Shrimp_Description.english: The sea's cleaner that lives on the ocean floor. Loved in many countries for its deliciousness.

SkeletalHand_Description.japanese: 小さなホネのひとかけらまでうしなわれず残っているすばらしい標本。
SkeletalHand_Description.english: A wonderful specimen where even the small bone fragments remain, none lost.

SkeletalTail_Description.japanese: しっぽのホネだが、かなり短い。
SkeletalTail_Description.english: It's a tail bone, but quite short.

SkillBook0_Description.japanese: これを読んで農業の経験を積もう。
SkillBook0_Description.english: Read this and gain experience in farming.

SkillBook1_Description.japanese: これを読んで釣りの経験を積もう。
SkillBook1_Description.english: Read this and gain experience in fishing.

SkillBook2_Description.japanese: これを読んで採取の経験を積もう。
SkillBook2_Description.english: Read this and gain experience in foraging.

SkillBook3_Description.japanese: これを読んで採鉱の経験を積もう。
SkillBook3_Description.english: Read this and gain experience in mining.

SkillBook4_Description.japanese: これを読んで戦闘の経験を積もう。
SkillBook4_Description.english: Read this and gain experience in combat.

Slate_Description.japanese: 非常に耐水性が高い鉱物。そのため、いい屋根の材料になる。
Slate_Description.english: A mineral with very high water resistance. Because of this, it makes good roofing material.

SlimeCharmerRing_Description.japanese: スライムから受けるダメージをふせぐ。

SlimeCrate_Description.japanese: 飼育しているスライムを別の場所に移すことができる。
SlimeCrate_Description.english: Allows you to move a slime you're raising to another location.

Slime_Description.japanese: てらてら光るゼラチン質のかたまり。まったくにおいがしない。
Slime_Description.english: A glistening, gelatinous lump. Has absolutely no smell.

Slimejack_Description.japanese: ぶあついスライムの層で身をおおっている。つかもうとするとニュルっとすべるぞ！
Slimejack_Description.english: Its body is covered in a thick layer of slime. If you try to grab it, it slips right out with a squelch!

SmallGlowRing_Description.japanese: ほのかな光でまわりを照らしてくれる。
SmallGlowRing_Description.english: Illuminates the surroundings with a faint light.

SmallMagnetRing_Description.japanese: アイテムをひろえる範囲がちょっと広くなる。
SmallMagnetRing_Description.english: The range for picking up items becomes a little wider.

SmallmouthBass_Description.japanese: 水のよごれにとても敏感。淡水に生息している。
SmallmouthBass_Description.english: Very sensitive to water pollution. Lives in fresh water.

SmokedFish_Description.japanese: {0}を丸一匹くんせいにしたもの。

Snail_Description.japanese: うずまき状のカラにすむ軟体動物。世界中に分布している。
Snail_Description.english: A mollusk that lives in a spiral shell. Distributed worldwide.

SnakeSkull_Description.japanese: 形を保った頭がい骨。かつてはヘビの身体の一部だった。
SnakeSkull_Description.english: A skull that has kept its shape. Once part of a snake's body.

SnakeVertebrae_Description.japanese: このヘビはとても柔軟だったようだ。
SnakeVertebrae_Description.english: This snake seems to have been very flexible.

SnowYam_Description.japanese: 雪の下にかくれている小さなイモ。
SnowYam_Description.english: A small tuber hiding beneath the snow.

SnowyStone_Description.japanese: 砕くと石、鉱石、ジオードなどが手に入る。
SnowyStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain stone, ore, geodes, and so on.

Soapstone_Description.japanese: 名前の由来はその軟らかさ。彫刻の材料として有名。
Soapstone_Description.english: Its name comes from its softness. Famous as a material for carving.

SolarEssence_Description.japanese: ほんのり光をはなつ物質。さわるとあたたかい。
SolarEssence_Description.english: A substance that gives off a faint glow. Warm to the touch.

SonarBobber_Description.japanese: 釣る前に食いついた魚の種類がわかる。
SonarBobber_Description.english: Lets you know the type of fish that bit before you catch it.

SonofCrimsonfish_Description.japanese: 夏の暖かな水の中でふ化して、父の跡を継いだ。
SonofCrimsonfish_Description.english: Hatched in the warm summer water, and succeeded his father.

SoulSapperRing_Description.japanese: モンスターを倒すたびに少しずつエナジーを得ることができる。
SoulSapperRing_Description.english: Each time you defeat a monster, you can gain a little energy.

Spaghetti_Description.japanese: 変わらない定番メニュー。

SpangleSeeds_Description.japanese: 夏植えの花。8日かけてはなやかな南国風の花を咲かせる。色は咲いてのおたのしみ。
SpangleSeeds_Description.english: A summer-planted flower. Takes 8 days to bloom into a gorgeous tropical-style flower. The color is a surprise for when it blooms.

SpeedGro_Description.japanese: 葉の成長を促進し、作物の成長速度を少なくとも10%上げる。たがやした土に混ぜてつかう。
SpeedGro_Description.english: Promotes leaf growth, raising crop growth speed by at least 10%. Mix into tilled soil.

SpiceBerry_Description.japanese: スパイシーな香りをあたりにふりまく夏のベリー。
SpiceBerry_Description.english: A summer berry that spreads a spicy aroma around it.

SpicyEel_Description.japanese: とっても辛い！食べるときは気をつけよう。
SpicyEel_Description.english: Very spicy! Be careful when eating it.

Spinner_Description.japanese: 水のなかで回転するルアー。つかうと釣りゲージが少したまりやすくなる。
Spinner_Description.english: A lure that spins in the water. Using it makes the fishing gauge fill a little more easily.

SpiritTorch_Description.japanese: どうして青く光るのか、その理由は明らかになっていない…
SpiritTorch_Description.english: Why it glows blue, the reason has not been made clear...

segments.text: 明らかになっていない…

SpookFish_Description.japanese: その大きな目でわずかな獲物の影も逃さない
SpookFish_Description.english: With its big eyes, it doesn't miss even the faintest shadow of prey.

SpringOnion_Description.japanese: 春になると生えてくる山菜。
SpringOnion_Description.english: A wild mountain plant that grows when spring comes.

SpringSeeds_Description.japanese: 春にとれる野草のタネのつめあわせ。
SpringSeeds_Description.english: An assortment of wild-grass seeds gathered in spring.

Sprinkler_Description.japanese: となりあった周囲の4マスに毎朝水をやってくれる。
Sprinkler_Description.english: Waters the surrounding 4 adjacent squares every morning.

SquidInkRavioli_Description.japanese: 能力低下から一時的に身を守る。
SquidInkRavioli_Description.english: Temporarily protects the body from debuffs.

SquidInk_Description.japanese: イカはこのインクを使って捕食者を混乱させます。
SquidInk_Description.english: Squid use this ink to confuse predators.

Squid_Description.japanese: 深い海に生息している生きもの。種によってはとんでもなく大きくなる。
Squid_Description.english: A creature that lives in the deep sea. Depending on the species, it can grow to an outrageous size.

StarShards_Description.japanese: その成り立ちはいまだに不明。ミクロレベルの構造が、自然物としては不自然に規則的だと主張する科学者たちもいる。
StarShards_Description.english: How it forms is still unknown. Some scientists claim its microscopic structure is unnaturally regular for a natural object.

StardewValleyRose_Description.japanese: 谷を思い起こさせるバラ。素晴らしい香りがする。
StardewValleyRose_Description.english: A rose that brings the valley to mind. Has a wonderful fragrance.

StardropTea_Description.japanese: みんなに喜ばれる特別な贈り物。
StardropTea_Description.english: A special gift that delights everyone.

Stardrop_Description.japanese: 食べた者に力をあたえるふしぎなフルーツ。その味は夢のようだと言われるが、エネルギーに満ちたその味を言いあらわすことは非常にむずかしい。
Stardrop_Description.english: A mysterious fruit that gives power to those who eat it. Its taste is said to be like a dream, but it's very difficult to put into words its energy-filled flavor.

StarfruitSeeds_Description.japanese: 夏植えの作物。そだつのに13日かかる。
StarfruitSeeds_Description.english: A summer-planted crop. Takes 13 days to grow.

Starfruit_Description.japanese: 熱くて湿度が高いところでそだつ、とてもジューシーなくだもの。すっぱさのなかにほのかなあまみがある。
Starfruit_Description.english: A very juicy fruit that grows in hot, humid places. Has a faint sweetness within its sourness.

SteppingStonePath_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して道をつくったり、地面を整えたりできる。
SteppingStonePath_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

Stingray_Description.japanese: 毒針を持っているが、恥ずかしがり屋なので人を避けようとする。
Stingray_Description.english: Has a poisonous stinger, but is shy and tries to avoid people.

StirFry_Description.japanese: 千切り野菜のいためもの。米にのせていただく。
StirFry_Description.english: Julienned stir-fried vegetables. Eaten on top of rice.

StoneBase_Description.japanese: シンプルな石のブロック。

StoneFence_Description.japanese: 木の柵よりながくもつ。
StoneFence_Description.english: Lasts longer than a wood fence.

StoneFloor_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して、道をつくったり地面を整えたりできる。
StoneFloor_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

StoneWalkwayFloor_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して、道をつくったり地面を整えたりできる。
StoneWalkwayFloor_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

Stone_Description.japanese: いろいろなクラフトや建築でつかう一般的な材料。
Stone_Description.english: A common material used in various crafting and construction.

Stone_NodeStoneOnly_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain stone.

Stone_NodeWithCoal_Description.japanese: 砕くと石が手に入る。石炭が含まれていることもある。
Stone_NodeWithCoal_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain stone. Coal may sometimes be included.

Stone_Node_Description.japanese: 砕くと石、鉱石、ジオードなどが手に入る。
Stone_Node_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain stone, ore, geodes, and so on.

Stonefish_Description.japanese: 岩のような見た目の変わった魚。
Stonefish_Description.english: A strange fish that looks like a rock.

StrawFloor_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して、道をつくったり地面を整えたりできる。
StrawFloor_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

StrawberrySeeds_Description.japanese: 春植えの作物。そだつのに8日かかる。最初の収穫のあともくりかえし収穫できる。
StrawberrySeeds_Description.english: A spring-planted crop. Takes 8 days to grow. Can be harvested repeatedly after the first harvest.

Strawberry_Description.japanese: あまくて果汁たっぷりの人気者。真っ赤な色が魅力的。
Strawberry_Description.english: A sweet, juicy favorite. Its bright red color is appealing.

Stuffing_Description.japanese: パン粉とセージの香りがただよう一品。
Stuffing_Description.english: A dish wafting with the aroma of breadcrumbs and sage.

SturdyRing_Description.japanese: 状態異常の効果時間を半分に減らす。
SturdyRing_Description.english: Reduces the duration of status ailments by half.

Sturgeon_Description.japanese: 海や川の底にすむ生きた化石。その数は減りつづけている。メスは150年も生きることがある。
Sturgeon_Description.english: A living fossil that lives at the bottom of the sea or rivers. Its numbers continue to decline. Females can live as long as 150 years.

Sugar_Description.japanese: 焼き菓子やキャンディをあまくしてくれる調味料。とりすぎると健康によくない。
Sugar_Description.english: A seasoning that sweetens baked goods and candy. Too much is bad for your health.

SummerSeeds_Description.japanese: 夏にとれる野草のタネのつめあわせ。
SummerSeeds_Description.english: An assortment of wild-grass seeds gathered in summer.

SummerSpangle_Description.japanese: 湿度の高い夏に咲く南国風の花。むせかえるようなあまい香りがする。
SummerSpangle_Description.english: A tropical-style flower that blooms in humid summer. Has a suffocatingly sweet aroma.

SummerSquashSeeds_Description.japanese: 夏植えの作物。そだつのに6日かかるが、つづけて収穫することができる。
SummerSquashSeeds_Description.english: A summer-planted crop. Takes 6 days to grow, but can be harvested continuously.

SummerSquash_Description.japanese: 曲がった黄色いスクワッシュ。柔らかく未熟なうちに収穫される。
SummerSquash_Description.english: A curved yellow squash. Harvested while soft and immature.

Sunfish_Description.english: A fish commonly seen in rivers.

SunflowerSeeds_Description.japanese: 秋植えの花。8日でおおきなヒマワリが咲く。収穫するとタネもとれる。
SunflowerSeeds_Description.english: A fall-planted flower. A large sunflower blooms in 8 days. Seeds are also obtained at harvest.

Sunflower_Description.japanese: よくまちがわれるが、いつも太陽のほうを向いているわけではない。
Sunflower_Description.english: It's often mistaken, but it doesn't always face toward the sun.

SuperCucumber_Description.japanese: 珍しいナマコの亜種。むらさき色をしている。
SuperCucumber_Description.english: A rare variety of sea cucumber. Is purple in color.

SuperMeal_Description.japanese: エネルギー補給にピッタリの一品。
SuperMeal_Description.english: A dish perfect for replenishing energy.

SurvivalBurger_Description.japanese: 探検するときに便利な携帯食。
SurvivalBurger_Description.english: A portable food convenient for exploring.

SweetGemBerry_Description.japanese: この世のなによりあまい香りをもつベリー。
SweetGemBerry_Description.english: A berry with a sweeter scent than anything else in this world.

SweetPea_Description.japanese: いい香りのする夏の花。
SweetPea_Description.english: A summer flower with a good scent.

TaroRoot_Description.japanese: もっとも古いの作物のひとつ。デンプンが豊富。
TaroRoot_Description.english: One of the oldest crops. Rich in starch.

TaroTuber_Description.japanese: 温暖な気候で育つ作物。育つのに10日かかる。水辺に植えると成長が早い。
TaroTuber_Description.english: A crop that grows in a warm climate. Takes 10 days to grow. Grows faster if planted near water.

TeaLeaves_Description.japanese: 茶樹の若い葉。ポピュラーで活気に満ちた飲み物に醸造することができます。
TeaLeaves_Description.english: The young leaves of the tea tree. Can be brewed into a popular, vigor-filled drink.

TeaSapling_Description.japanese: 成熟するのに20日かかります。冬を除く各シーズンの最終週に茶葉を生産します。じょうろは必要ありません。
TeaSapling_Description.english: Takes 20 days to mature. Produces tea leaves in the final week of each season except winter. A watering can isn't necessary.

TeaSet_Description.japanese: 上品な陶磁器のセット。

TentKit_Description.japanese: 寝るためのテントを一度だけ張ることができる。野外でしか使用できない。
TentKit_Description.english: Lets you pitch a tent for sleeping, one time only. Can only be used outdoors.

ThornsRing_Description.japanese: 敵からダメージを受けると、敵にもダメージを与える。
ThornsRing_Description.english: When you take damage from an enemy, you deal damage to the enemy too.

ThunderEgg_Description.japanese: 雷の精霊たちがケンカで投げあった雷のタマゴが大地に落ちてきたものだという伝説がある。
ThunderEgg_Description.english: There's a legend that these are thunder eggs, thrown at each other in a fight by thunder spirits, that fell to the earth.

TigerSlimeEgg_Description.japanese: スライムふ卵器でかえすことができます。取り扱いにはご注意ください！
TigerSlimeEgg_Description.english: Can be hatched in a slime incubator. Please handle with care!

TigerTrout_Description.japanese: ちがう種のマスが交配して生まれたレアな雑種。自分では子孫を残せない。
TigerTrout_Description.english: A rare hybrid born from different trout species crossbreeding. Cannot leave offspring of its own.

Tigerseye_Description.japanese: キラキラした金色のしまもようが、ぬくもりあるかがやきを生みだしている。
Tigerseye_Description.english: A sparkling golden striped pattern produces a warm luster.

Tilapia_Description.japanese: あたたかい水に生息する魚。主に植物をエサとする。
Tilapia_Description.english: A fish that lives in warm water. Mainly eats plants.

TomKhaSoup_Description.japanese: 絶妙な風味がたまらない！

TomatoSeeds_Description.japanese: 夏植えの作物。そだつのに11日かかるが、最初の収穫のあともくりかえし収穫できる。
TomatoSeeds_Description.english: A summer-planted crop. Takes 11 days to grow, but can be harvested repeatedly after the first harvest.

Tomato_Description.japanese: 濃いうまみのなかにかすかなすっぱさがある。さまざまな料理でつかわれる。
Tomato_Description.english: Has a faint sourness within a rich umami. Used in various dishes.

TopazRing_Description.japanese: 武器の命中率が10%上がる。

TopazStone_Description.japanese: 砕くとトパーズが手に入る。
TopazStone_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain topaz.

Topaz_Description.japanese: レア度は低いがうつくしい宝石。
Topaz_Description.english: A gem that's low in rarity, but beautiful.

Torch_Description.japanese: 周囲をほどほどに照らしてくれる。

Tortilla_Description.japanese: そのままでも、なにかを巻いて食べてもおいしい。
Tortilla_Description.english: Delicious as-is, or delicious eaten wrapped around something.

TrapBobber_Description.japanese: セットすると、リールを巻いていないあいだは魚のスピードがおそくなる。
TrapBobber_Description.english: Once equipped, the fish's speed becomes slower while you aren't reeling in.

TreasureChest_Description.japanese: なかにお宝が入った箱。きっと値打ちものが入っているはず。
TreasureChest_Description.english: A box with treasure inside. Surely something valuable must be inside.

TreasureHunter_Description.japanese: お宝をあつめている間は魚が逃げなくなる。お宝のみつかる確率が少しだけ上がる。
TreasureHunter_Description.english: While collecting treasure, fish stop escaping. Also slightly raises the probability of finding treasure.

TreasureTotem_Description.japanese: 掘れる地面で使うと、リング状の宝物スポットを召喚する。
TreasureTotem_Description.english: If used on diggable ground, summons a ring-shaped arrangement of treasure spots.

TreeFertilizer_Description.japanese: 野生の木にふりかけて、冬でも急速な成長を確保します。果樹には効果がありません。
TreeFertilizer_Description.english: Sprinkle on a wild tree to ensure rapid growth even in winter. Has no effect on fruit trees.

Trilobite_Description.japanese: 大むかしに絶滅したカニの仲間。
Trilobite_Description.english: A relative of the crab that went extinct long ago.

TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Description.japanese: 豪華なゴールドが付いたパープルシルクショートパンツ...
TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Description.english: Purple silk short pants with luxurious gold trim...

TripleShotEspresso_Description.japanese: 通常のコーヒーよりも強めです。

TropicalCurry_Description.japanese: パイナップルの器に盛られた、エキゾチックで香ばしいカレー。
TropicalCurry_Description.english: An exotic, fragrant curry served in a pineapple bowl.

TroutDerbyTag_Description.japanese: マス釣り大会のブースに持って行くと賞品と交換してもらえる。
TroutDerbyTag_Description.english: If you take it to the trout-fishing tournament booth, they'll exchange it for a prize.

TruffleOil_Description.japanese: トリュフの香りをすいこんだ美味なオイル。
TruffleOil_Description.english: A delicious oil that has absorbed truffle's aroma.

Truffle_Description.japanese: その独特の味わいゆえに美食家に愛されるキノコ。
Truffle_Description.english: A mushroom loved by gourmets for its distinctive flavor.

TulipBulb_Description.japanese: 春植えの花。6日かけてきれいな花を咲かせる。色は咲いてのおたのしみ。
TulipBulb_Description.english: A spring-planted flower. Takes 6 days to bloom into a beautiful flower. The color is a surprise for when it blooms.

Tulip_Description.japanese: 春の花の代表格。ほのかにあまい香りがする。
Tulip_Description.english: The representative spring flower. Has a faintly sweet scent.

Tuna_Description.japanese: 海に生息するからだの大きい魚。
Tuna_Description.english: A large-bodied fish that lives in the sea.

Twig_Description.japanese: 折れた枝。オノで切ると木材が手に入る。
Twig_Description.english: A broken branch. Cut with an axe to obtain wood.

UnmilledRice_Description.japanese: 生の形の米。これをミルに通して値を増やします。
UnmilledRice_Description.english: Rice in its raw form. Run it through a mill to increase its value.

VampireRing_Description.japanese: モンスターを倒すごとに、体力がすこし回復する。
VampireRing_Description.english: Every time you defeat a monster, health recovers a little.

VegetableMedley_Description.japanese: とっても栄養たっぷりな一皿。
VegetableMedley_Description.english: A dish that's very packed with nutrition.

Vinegar_Description.japanese: 何年も発酵させてつくった調味料。いろいろなレシピでつかえる。
Vinegar_Description.english: A seasoning made by fermenting for many years. Usable in various recipes.

VoidEgg_Description.japanese: 赤いはん点が散っている漆黒のタマゴ。さわるとあたたかい。
VoidEgg_Description.english: A jet-black egg with red speckles scattered on it. Warm to the touch.

VoidEssence_Description.japanese: 闇のエネルギーをたたえた物質。こきざみにふるえている。
VoidEssence_Description.english: A substance filled with dark energy. Trembling in small shudders.

VoidGhostPendant_Description.japanese: 影の人々を象徴しています。ギフトとして、友達のように一緒に移動したいという願望を芽生えさせます。
VoidGhostPendant_Description.english: It symbolizes the Shadow People. As a gift, it sprouts a desire to move together like friends.

VoidMayonnaise_Description.japanese: どろっとした黒いペースト。焦げたかみの毛のにおいがする。
VoidMayonnaise_Description.english: A thick, gloopy black paste. Smells like burnt hair.

VoidSalmon_Description.japanese: 闇のエネルギーで変異したサケ。真っ黒な身は、空気にさらせばすぐピンクに変わる。
VoidSalmon_Description.english: A salmon mutated by dark energy. Its jet-black flesh quickly turns pink when exposed to air.

VolcanoGoldNode_Description.japanese: 割ると金鉱石が手に入る。
VolcanoGoldNode_Description.english: If you break it, you obtain gold ore.

Walleye_Description.japanese: 夜釣りで釣れる淡水魚。
Walleye_Description.english: A freshwater fish caught by night fishing.

WarMemento_Description.english: A faded photograph of a soldier...

WarpTotemBeach_Description.japanese: つかうと浜辺にワープする。一度つかうとなくなる。
WarpTotemBeach_Description.english: If used, warps you to the beach. Disappears once used.

WarpTotemDesert_Description.japanese: つかうと砂漠にワープする。一度つかうとなくなる。
WarpTotemDesert_Description.english: If used, warps you to the desert. Disappears once used.

WarpTotemFarm_Description.japanese: つかうと牧場にワープする。一度つかうとなくなる。
WarpTotemFarm_Description.english: If used, warps you to the ranch. Disappears once used.

WarpTotemIsland_Description.japanese: つかうとジンジャーアイランドにワープする。一度つかうとなくなる。
WarpTotemIsland_Description.english: If used, warps you to Ginger Island. Disappears once used.

segments.text: ジンジャーアイランドに

WarpTotemMountains_Description.japanese: つかうと山にワープする。一度つかうとなくなる。
WarpTotemMountains_Description.english: If used, warps you to the mountain. Disappears once used.

WarpTotemQisArena_Description.japanese: Qiアリーナにワープする。覚悟を決めて挑戦しよう！
WarpTotemQisArena_Description.english: Warps you to Qi's Arena. Steel your resolve and take on the challenge!

WarriorRing_Description.japanese: モンスターを倒すと、ときどき“戦士のエナジー”が発動する。
WarriorRing_Description.english: When you defeat a monster, 'warrior's energy' sometimes activates.

WeatheredFloor_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して、道をつくったり地面を整えたりできる。
WeatheredFloor_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

WeddingRing_Description.japanese: ズズシティの伝統…牧場主がプロポーズするときの必需品とされてきた。
WeddingRing_Description.english: A Zuzu City tradition... considered a necessity when a rancher proposes marriage.

Weeds_DryBush_Description.japanese: 乾燥した草のかたまり。 Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
Weeds_DryBush_Description.english: A clump of dried grass. Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.

segments.text: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.

Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Description.japanese: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Description.english: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.

segments.text: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.

Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Ugly_Description.japanese: やっかいな雑草。 Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Ugly_Description.english: Troublesome weeds. Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.

segments.text: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.

Weeds_Fiber_Ugly_Description.japanese: ジャマな雑草の束。 Cut to obtain wild seeds.
Weeds_Fiber_Ugly_Description.english: A bundle of annoying weeds. Cut to obtain wild seeds.

WheatFlour_Description.japanese: 一般的な食材。くだいたコムギからつくられる。
WheatFlour_Description.english: A common ingredient. Made from crushed wheat.

WheatSeeds_Description.japanese: 夏または秋植えの作物。そだつのに4日かかる。収穫にはカマが必要。
WheatSeeds_Description.english: A summer- or fall-planted crop. Takes 4 days to grow. A scythe is needed to harvest.

Wheat_Description.japanese: 世界でもっとも栽培されている穀物のひとつ。粉にすると、パンやケーキの材料になる。
Wheat_Description.english: One of the most widely cultivated grains in the world. When ground into flour, it becomes an ingredient for bread and cake.

WhiteAlgae_Description.japanese: めちゃくちゃぬるぬる。

WhiteEgg_Description.japanese: 白いニワトリのタマゴ。

WildBait_Description.japanese: ライナスから教えてもらった特製のエサ。一度に2匹の魚が釣れる。
WildBait_Description.english: A special bait taught by Linus. Lets you catch 2 fish at once.

WildHorseradish_Description.japanese: ピリッと辛い根っこ。春の野で採れる。
WildHorseradish_Description.english: A sharply spicy root. Gathered in spring fields.

WildPlum_Description.japanese: すっぱくてジューシー。濃厚な香りをただよわせている。
WildPlum_Description.english: Sour and juicy. Gives off a rich aroma.

WiltedBouquet_Description.japanese: デートをやめたい時に使えるギフト。
WiltedBouquet_Description.english: A gift usable when you want to stop dating someone.

WinterSeeds_Description.japanese: 冬にとれる野草のタネのつめあわせ。
WinterSeeds_Description.english: An assortment of wild-grass seeds gathered in winter.

WoodFence_Description.japanese: 牧草や動物たちを囲うのにぴったり！
WoodFence_Description.english: Perfect for enclosing pasture grass and animals!

WoodFloor_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して、道をつくったり地面を整えたりできる。
WoodFloor_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

WoodPath_Description.japanese: 地面に設置して、道をつくったり地面を整えたりできる。
WoodPath_Description.english: Place it on the ground; you can make paths or tidy up the ground.

Wood_Description.japanese: がんじょうさと柔軟さをかねそなえた素材。さまざまなつかい道がある。
Wood_Description.english: A material with both sturdiness and flexibility. Has various uses.

Woodskip_Description.japanese: 環境の変化にびんかんな魚。森の奥ふかくにある池にしか生息できない。
Woodskip_Description.english: A fish sensitive to environmental change. Can only live in ponds deep within the forest.

Wool_Description.japanese: やわらかくてふわふわのウール。

WrigglingWorm_Description.japanese: くねくね動く、湿った虫。
WrigglingWorm_Description.english: A wet bug that wriggles and squirms.

YamSeeds_Description.japanese: 秋植えの作物。そだつのに10日かかる。
YamSeeds_Description.english: A fall-planted crop. Takes 10 days to grow.

Yam_Description.japanese: 多彩な料理につかわれるほくほくしたイモ。
Yam_Description.english: A fluffy, starchy tuber used in a variety of dishes.
